tei:div.tei:p: ——3 dag snang las byin 'bebs yid bzhen char 'bebs bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na sa ra byeḥ shā sa ste/ sbyar sbos bdug cing rol mo 'brol snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad gyer hrī ka dag gnying gsal klong yangs nas ye grol chos sku kun bzang mo rgyal bathams cad bskyed pa'i dbyings: gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa sbor: lhun grub 'od gsal bde klong nas: rang grol longs sku rnal 'byor ma: bde ba'i mthar son stong pa'idabyings: gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa spor zung 'jug thugs rje'i gting klong nas: shar grol sprul sku mtsho rgyal ma: bde stong zung 'jug dbyings nyid las: gnas 'dirabyin phob rtogs pa spor chos nyid dag pa'i dbyings nyid las: gnas kyi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma: rdo rje'i rigs ni bsam yas pas: gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa spor: ye shes dwangs ma'i dbyings nyid las: he ru ka yi thabs shes tshogs: bud+dhā'i rigs mchog ma lus pas: gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa spor: rang rgyud kyi nai dbyings nyid las

yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma: pad+ma'i rigs ni chags bral rnams: gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa sbor: yon tan lhun rdzogs dbyings nyid las: dur khrod brgyad kyi rnal 'byor ma: yon tan phrin las rigs kun gyis: gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa spor yang dag don gyi dbyings nyid las: chos sku longs sku sprul ba'i sku sku gsum ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa spor: dwangs ma lnga yi dbyings nyid nas rgyu la gnas pa bde sa'i gzugs: lhan skyes phyag rgya'i tshogs rnams kyis: gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa sbor: ye shes nam mkha'i gzugs can ni: rjes chags pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: shin tu bde ba chen po'i sku'i: gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa sbor sgyu lus ye shes me yis sbyangs: zhu bde'i rang bzhin 'bar bas smin: 'gyur med dbu ma'i stobs su rdzogs sku gsum ye shes byin phob cig sa pad+mo yo ki ni dzñā na sa ra dza ya gu rgya 11 dhi tsit+ta dzñā na dhartu a be sha ya a ā: rtogs pa hur byung rol mo 'khrol snyan pa'i glus bskul gzi byin pheb nyams rtogs yar ngos zla ltar 'phel bde stong ye shes mngon sum 'char sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya skal ldan
da pa/ gcig dang 'phrad par shog gu rgya brda thim lha rat+na sarasachasaskal byin rlabs khyad par can no sarba maṅga lam

—1 dag snang las rjemomatsha rgyal gnad bskul bzhugasaso:ma sam sbyar sbos bdug cang thod rnga khrol snyan pa'i glu yas 'di skad gyer trī dza: bde ba snyin pa'i yid 'ong ma: lha mo'i gzugs can pad+ma'i lcam: ma khyod dran bzhin dad pas bskul: ye shes gzigs pa'i bdag la phyogs chos sku'i zhing na kun bzang mo: longs sku'i gnas su rnal 'byor ma sprul sku ye shes mtsho rgyal dpal mkha' 'gro 'bum bcas gnad nas bskul: gnas pa rtsa khams nyer gzhi'i dal: g.yo ba rlung ni so gnyis gnas bkod pa dur khrod he ru'i zhing: der bzhugs dpal bo rnal 'byer ma 'bar ba'i bde ba mchog la byon: bcu drug dga' ba'i rta bro brdung: mi 'gyur 'od gsal gar chen bsgyur: 'dzig med na dwa'i glu la dgongs sha dang sa yi dwangs ma gser: sra ba'i dbyings kyis khams gsum brten: rnam dag sangs rgyas yon tan gter: rin chen rigs kyi grub mchog stsol: khrag dang chu mi dwangs ma mtshal: mnyam pa'i dbyings kyi dwangs gsher brdal: rnam

dag ye shes gsang ba che:rdo rje rigs kyi grub mchog stsol: dbugs dang rlung gi dwangs ma rlangs: yangs shing g.yo ba'i kun 'jug dbyings: 'od lnga'i drwa ba zhu bde'i mdzod: lasarab rigs kyi grub mchog stsol: sems dang nam mkha'i dwangs ma mkha': khyabs cing brdal la go skabs 'byed: srid zhi gnyis med bde ba che sangs rgyas rigs kyi grub mchogastsol: ye shes nam mkha'i gzugs can ni: ma lus 'dus pa'i thig le che rgyal ba kun bdag gzigs pa dngos: shes rab chen por ci bzhin stsol: sa chu sha khrag dag pa sku: merlung drod dbugs grol ba gsung mkha' sems yongs smin thugs rdo rje gsang gsum mnyam rdzogs grub mchog stsol: salam bag chags rang grol te: 'od gsal dhu ti'idagongs klong sad: kun gzigs mkha' spyod zhal mthong nas: sprul bsgyur gzhan don nus par mdzod: bsam gtan ma rig sbubs grol te srid pa'i drwa ba kun chod nas mkha' ltar mnyam pa'i mkha' spyod zhal: rig pa rang grol rtogs par mdzod skye gnas bar do'i zhen 'dzin grol: thos bsam sgom sgrubs byed pa la: lha mo khyod kyi rjes

——3 bzung nas: sa lam nyams rtogs gong 'phel mdzod: 'chi kha bar do gnad gcod dben grong 'pho grong 'jug gnad gsum lam ma pang bu 'jug 'byung ba'i phyir mkha' 'gro khyod kyis 'bral med skyongs chos nyid bar do'i sgra 'od zer sku dang ye shes zung 'jug dang lhun grub rang snang ngo shes nas: ma khyod mkha' slong mngon gyur mdzod srid pa bar do'i 'khrul snang grol: mngon shes rjes dran thams cad thobs mgon khyod rol mo'i sgra bcas byon: mngon gsum dpal rir lam sna drongs: med snang bdud bzhi'i bsgru rkyen dang: rang mtshan gol ba'i nyon mongs dgra: bag chags las snang g.yang sa drug: ma khyod thugs rjes nyer zhi mdzod: rgyu lus zag pa zhi bde'i mes: dwangs ma ye shes 'od lngar smin: mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rjer nye ru ka dpal mchog spyod mdzod: bdag ni skye dang tshe rabs kun: pad+ma'i rigs mchog rgyal ba dang: ma khyod phrin las par gyur nas: snga 'gyur bstan 'dzin dam pa mdzod bdag mthong dran reg 'gro ba kun bskyed dang rdzogs rims zhu bde'i lam: byams dang snying rje smon lam gyis: gang

'brel dpal rir sun ma mchosad: mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen 'dar tshogs ston mchod pa 'bul legs na 'ja' 'byugs dri bzang rol mo'i sgra mngon gsum rjes bzungs rtags mtshan ston rnal 'phyor nyams 'ur rtogs pa sbor shes pa byung rgyal rig ro sprod mi 'gyur gdengs bzhi'i drod thob nas nyid dang dbyer med mdzad du gsol sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim lha rat+na sa ras chos skal lo sabo maṅga lam/

—1 dag snang las je lbo marwadza rgyal masabasnyed pa byen rlabs gnad bskul bzhugs soḥgagagrams nyi skye mid mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings nyid laḥ ye shes gting gsal de bzhin nyid bzhugs paḥ bde gshegs yongs 'dus nang dbyings bum pa skuḥ kun tubazang mo spros dang bral la bstodaX lhun grub 'du ma byas pa 'od gsal dbyingasaḥ ngang mdangs sku dang ye shes yon tan gter mdangs snang ma 'gags rang byung rol ba'i brgyanardo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: mkhyen pa'i ye shes sgron me 'od stong 'bar: brtse chen thugs rje'i gzigs pa chags thogs bral: nus pa'i blo gros pakhro'i gter rdolab ngag dbang dbyangs can lha mor phyag 'tshal bstod: bod khams mun sel sangs rgyas pad+ma'i lcam: zab lam dgyes sde gter gyi sgrub sde mo: phrin las grub brnyes phur thogasayongs kyi rje: mkhar chen grub pa'i rgyal mor phyag 'tshal bstod mthengo bas 7) 'phradon mtshan dpe'i zhal bzang ngoms: thos pa'i rnams grol 'gags med brda' chos 'gyed

dran pas mod la bde chen ye shes sbyin: pad+ma'i zhal bzang mtsho rgyal dbyings la bstod sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba mchog 'dzin cing: mi byed ye shes bde ba sbyin pa'i ma skal ldan sa lam brda' dang thabs kyis ston 'gro 'dren ded dpon ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: rigs sngags zhing skyes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: tshogs kyi zhing nyul gnas yul dur khrod bdag: re 'ga' mi mo'i tshul gyis zhu bde sbyin: 'brel tshad mkha' spyod dbang mor phyag 'tshal bstod: dwangs ma lnga 'dus gsang 'byung gnas yul brten: shes rab stog ldan kun la 'jug pa can: khyab byed chen mo ye shes nam mkha'i gzugs lhan skyes bde sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: gter rgya mchog gter ston pa'i lde'u mig byedaḥ gtad rgya dam pa'i chos kyi gab gsang 'byed: sbas rgya:gnas nas bka' gtad phyag rgya bkrol zab rgya:gsang chen 'dzin ma khyod la bstod: phun tshogs dum cig mi yi nor bu na ro mnyam sha lnga dam rdzas che ba'i mchog: dngos kun bdud rtsi nyid du grub mdzad pas byin rlabs char 'bebs sa ra dza la bstod: rdzu 'phrul thog zer mdzub mo'i rtse la dkris ye

—11 shes mchog grub bsad pa'i mi ro bslang: dam tshog dag pa'i thugs kye man ngag gnang: snod ldan gzung ma mtsho rgyal yum la bstod: mdzad pa'i rnam thar sku yi yonatan kun: thos dang dran pas bdag sems rtsegacig g.yos: de ba'i khyed thugs rtsal g.yos gzigs pa ngoms: mngon gsum mkha' spyod gnas su lam sna drongs: sku yis rjesabazung gsung gi bdud rtsi nod: thugs kyi dgongs brgyud rtogs pa btsan thabs 'phos: bzang ngan las kyi 'brel ba'i gdul zhing bcas: mi ldog mgon khyod zhabs drunga'atshogs par regag: de ltar bsto cing gsol btab na dbang dang byan rlabs dngos grub stsol nyams rtogs yar ngos zla ltar 'phel mkha' 'gros bu bzhin skyo sa bar 'gyur sa ma mā thugs kya sras dang 'phrad par shog rgyargya rgya gu h+ye brda tham snyi rat+na sa ras bgo skal du gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro'i snying thig zab mo'o sarba maṅga lam/

zhesaX mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni hrī: dmigs med stong pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las: gsal stong 'gags med kun bzang rol ba'i rgyan: phye nang gsang mchod bde stong lha mor bcas: rgyal ba kun yum dgyes pa bskangs phyir spel: ces ma hā a nu ra ga na badz+ra pu dza spra ra ṇa sa: spel sngags ga 'os brjod la spro sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya brda thim snyi zhes sngags kyis rnal 'byor pad+ma'i ming can nas bskul ro ra nus ldan pas spel ba ma lam

tshang skyabasayulagasal ba ni mdun gyi nam mkhar dhu ma tha la o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling: 'ja' 'od kye gur khyim phub cing bde stong spros pa dang bral ba'i 'od gsal 'bar ba byerdo po'i gzi byin 'khyugs pa'i klong nas: rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'dzum pa'i dpal stong 'byugs cing: brtse ba'i zur mig g.yo bzhin bde stong gi 'char sgo ngoms nas rus rgyan dril g.yel kyi sgras snang ba bskul zhing rlung sems kyi spros pa thad gar gcod la: gnas yul dur khrod he ru ga'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad nye 'du mdzad cing bde stong spros pa dang bral ba'i 'od gsal chen po'i dgongs nyams la gnas shing rjes chags rol ba'i gar nyams skal ldan sgrub pa po rnams la phyogs par bsam la: skyabs sems tshogs bsags byas mthar dza hūṃ be ho: dza gas zhing rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas bde stong chags thog bral ba'i 'od gsal 'bar bar bsam mo : de yang sgrub pa'i cha lags su pa d+ma'i mos blos bskul ba'i ngor nus lngan rol ba'i rdo rjes spel sgrub bstan 'dzug pa' sgyur gyur cig sarba masgo lam

——— dag snang las yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs pa 'dod 'dzo bum bzang bzhugasaso:tswa na 1k+ki padro yo kai ni ya ratswagargasgawaṃ e ma ho stong chen dag pa nyi ldan chos kyi dbyings: lhun grub bum pa sku yi pho brang nas: rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rjes chagasaba'ad pa'i rnam 'gyur mtsho rgyal yum: sangs rgyas pad+ma'i lcam mo khyod dran bzhin: rtse gcig dad pas gsol ba 'debs lags na: snying dbus dwangs ma lnga ldan rab smin te thugs gsang sku yi rdo rjer yongs bzhengs nas: sgyu lus 'od gsal phyag rgya chen por sad: grong 'pho grong 'jug nang dbyings dpal gyi rir: rang rig ngo bo bla ma pad 'byung dang rje 'bang lo paṇa bshad sgrub mdzad pa'i gral: phun tshogs lnga ldan dpal la longs spyod nas: gang 'dul sprul ba'i 'gro don byed par shog de ltar gsol btabs byin rlabs 'jug dgosabargyud pha phog zab mo 'thob 'pho chen 'ja' sku 'grub pa' lam las can gcig dang 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya: brda thim snyi thab grogs rat+na sa ras chos skal lo sarba maṅga lam

—— dag snang las: sgrub pa la 'jug tshe sngon 'gro'i rim pa bdud las rnam rgyal bzhugs so:mdzathasposgo— dkar gtor dang 'o skyems ༅mas phral t+t+waṃ: pad+ma'i yol ko rgya che khyod yangs nang: dkar bgos 'o phud zag med bdud rtsir gyur: tshe uhūṃ7) rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis stong gsum nas: gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyongs rnams spyan drangs gyur dza: nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhir brten bcas pa'i: che ba'i mthu ldan dregs pa'i rtsal thob pa dbang phyug chung ma dri za grul bum klu: gnod sbyin nam mkha' lding dang lto 'bye gnyan: 'dab bzang lus srul po dang sa bdag gtod: yul gzhi'i bdag po dkar nag gnyis skyongs rnams dkar dmar gtor ma dza gad skyems bzang po: bzhes la sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang: rnal 'byor grogs mdzod phyi nang nyer 'tshe bzlog: sa lam nyams rtogs yar ngos zla ltar spel: grub pa'i 'bras bu myur du stsol ba dang: sems can bde skyid ldan pa'i brin las mdzod: bgegs gtor dang chang glud bshams phral yo h+ya hṝ wa hūṃ phaṭa:

tram̐.as rin chen snod du oṃ yig las glud gtor 'chi gsos bdud rtsi'i phung por gyur: oṃ āḥ/ ho: a ka ro bha ras sngags kyis glud gtor spel te:trī: nga ni 'bar ba dbang gi sku rjes chags bzhad glus khams gsum 'dul: 'di na gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba'i gdon lan chags glud kyis brngan zin pas: 'tshe bar ma byed phyir dengs shig u tsa ta ya phaṭa zung spyor ni tī stong nyid mi 'gyur rdo rje'i klong: mtshon chen ye shes rwa gur gtams gnyis snang 'byung pos glag mi snyed: byang chub sems su lhun gyis grub: dzñā na dhartu rak+ta hūṃ brda ོ dbye ba ni ho: chos sku thig le nyag gcig la: ye shes phyogs ras bral ba'i sgo gnyis med mnyam nyid ma rtog pas ma rig sgrib pa bsal bar bya hūṃ mtshul pra we sha ya phaṭa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni trī: bde dang stong pa'i rang mdangs su: thams cad dpa' bo yab yum dal: zung 'jug dga' bzhi'i nyams gyur can 'gyur med ga ga ma'i brda phyag 'tshal sa ma ya na mo ho: dam bca' bzung ba ni ho lhan skyes bde ba chen po ru ye nas mnyam spyor rjes chags sku pad+ma'i rigs mchog yab yum dal srog gi gta' ru mi

—1 gtong 'dzin:sa ma ya tset+ta hā:༅gsapa na ho:nyag gcag klong yangs bde ba che bā ga bde ba chen po rtsa'akhor 'das mnyam brdal bde stong gzugs:ma rig rtog sgrib bag chags bshags:sa ma ya bhi 85bye yisade ltar yang zab sgrub pa la 'jug tshe sngon du 'gro ba'i chos yan lag lta bu'i gdam pa 'di thugs kyi srasadang 'phrad par shog:sam mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya:brda jim snyi las ldan rat+na sa ra'i chos kyas skal ba'o sarba maṅga lam/

—5 dag snang las mkha' 'gro'i rtsa sgrub mun sel sgron me bzhugs so:na re dzñā sa ra dza ye:mnaskagazatsa bdeb sbyin pa'i yid 'ong ma lha mo' mchog khyod dran pa'i mdo snying dbus pad+mo zum phyes nas lhan skyes mkha' 'gro mjal la 'dud mi med ṭa ṭa'i ke'u tshang du chag bral bya ba bta ba'i mis sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'dzan pa la ma/kha' 'gro'i dam tshag 'di nyid zu sa sa ma yā smin byed dbang gsargyud smin cing dam tshag sdom pa rnam dag pas sgo gsum bag phab bde bar gnas bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i las gzhungabasrengs sa ma yu 'di la spyo don rnam gsum las sngon 'gro bca' bshams da la bkod dum gcig ma yi nor bu ru bzang drug rin chen sna tshogs gtam mkha' 'gro'i sku gzugs tshogs bcas bkod gu ru yab yum bya semasakyis hrī bkod la rab tu gnas tshogs ston phyi na bkod pas mchod de nas sgrub pa mchog la 'jug sa ma yu skyabs 'gro ni na re gang zhig dran pas bde stong 'char:lhan skyes ye shes sbyin pa'i ma rigs kun 'dus zhal mkha' 'gro'i gtso:rnal 'byor ma la skyabs su mchi sems bskyed ni he 'de ra 'das dag pa rab 'byams la:gdos por blta ba'i 'dzin stang 'di gzhi

rtsa bral bar ka dag phyir dbyings kyi yum chen bsgom par bya tshogasabasags ni na mo mkha' klong mnyam pa'i phyag rgya la: bde stong rang zhal mjal phyag mtshal: dga' bzhi ye shes mchod pa 'bul nyon mongs rang mtshan 'khrul ba bshags dbyings ye mnyam rdzogs rjes yi rang: zhu bde 'gyur med chos 'khor bskul 'od gsal 'pho 'gyur bral b.rabazhugs: dge kun lhun grub chen por bsngo: phun tshogs lnga ldan gter thob shog: byin 'bebs ni hrī: dhu ma tha la mkha' 'gro'i gling: o rgyan yul gyi gnas mchog nas pad+ma'i lcam gcig mtsho rgyal ma: dpa' bo 'kha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas gnas 'dir byon la byin chen phob: bu la dbang bskur rtogs pa spor: o dzñā na ṭasko ni a ra li phem phem: mchod rdzas byin r+ṣas ni hrī: sna tshogs gdos por bzung ba'i chos: gdod nas dag mnyam dgongs pa yis mchod pa'i bye brag bsam mtha' yas mkha' khyab 'khor lo'i rgyan du spel: 37 ā hūṃ ha ho hrī sngon 'gro' rim pa'o sa ma yu lha bskyed ni u snang ba ka dag yum lnga'i mkha': srid pa bde stong mkha' 'gro'i gling rgyu

—11 rkyen las 'das gzhal med khang: thig le nyag gcig 'od gsal klong: brda don rtags bkod rdzogs pa'i dbus: ma chags bde sbyin pad nyi'i khar rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i dbyings: po:las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar gsal sor rtogs ye shes zhal: gcer mo mnyam pa'i dor stabs can: zhi 'dzum lang tsho'i dpal gyis 'khyud:gnag snum dbu skra rat+nas brgyan: ka ma la yi do shal 'phyangs: phyag zhabs mu tig gdu bu la: pad+ma rā ga'i phra yi mdzes dar dpyangs rus pa'i rgyan drug spras: chos nyid spyan ni dbyings la gzigs shes rab kyis ni bde stong 'gugs: snying rje'i gzigs pas nyon mongs sgrol: phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te'u 'khrol: g.yon pas gri gug dku la brten:nu 'bur bde sbyin pad mo rgyas: thugs gar dpal gyi be'u'i klong: kun bzang yab yum nam mkha'i mdog: dbang po dag pa' rtsa dang rlung: phyi nang sems dpa' de yi yum: rnam shes gzugs tshor 'du shes la: 'du byed 'byung khams rigs lnga yum: nyon mongs gnas dag thub pa drug: yan lag mu bzhi rang grol ba: 'thar byed yab yub brgyad kyi dal

chos nyid mnyam pa'i rtsa khams la: gnas kyi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'od zer zlum la kun tu gzhi'i: rdo rje'i rigs ni bsam mtha' yas: ye shes dwangs ma'i rtsa khams la heru ka yi thabs shes tshogs 'od mthing dkyus mar yid kyi shes budha'i rigs rnams bde ba che: rang rgyud kyis nirtsa khams la: yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma: 'od dmar zlagam nyon mongs yid: pad+ma'i rigs kun chags pa bral: yon tan gyis ni rtsa khams la dur khrod brgyad kyi rnal 'byor tshogs: 'od dmar nag la sgo lnga'i shes yon tan phrinalas rigs kun rdzogs: yang dag don gyi rtsa khams la: chos kyi sku dang ma ngas spyod rdzogs sprul sku ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams: sku gsung thugs su lhun gyis grub: dwangs ma lnga 'dus dkyil 'khor las: sra ba'i dbyings kyis khams gsum brten dwangs shing gsher bas mnyam par byed: 'bar zhing bskyed pas sgron mer 'gyur: yangs shing g.yo bas kun la 'jug: khyab cing brdal bas go skabs 'byed: nam mkha'i gzugs can ye shes ni byang chub sems kyi thig le che: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du

7༷ bzhugs:srog gi dwangs ma ye shes sems:mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i gsang mdzod gter:dbyings dang 'jig rten sha za mo:dam tshig 'gags med lhun gyis grub (dro bdag pad 'byung a tsar+ya:dkar gsal cang te' jil bu 'khrol:he ru ka dpal cha lugs can dran pa tsam gyis dngos grub 'thob:sgog gis bskul te 'og min nas:yeshes lha tshogs spyan drangs bstims:spyana'adren ni nyu:a rgyan mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling:dpal ri pad ma 'od kyi zhing:'du ba chen po'i grong khyer nas:bde ba mchog ldan ṭāk+ki'irje:ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma:dad pas bskul brda' gsol gdab bcas:gdung bas dbyangs kyis spyan 'dren na:skal ldan mos mtshor da chur byon:dbang bskur byinarlobs rtogs pa sbor:nyid dang dbyer med mdzad du gsol:o pad+mo yo kai ni sarba sa ma ya dza e h+ya hi:bzhugs gsol ni hrī:lha nyid rang la rang nyid lha:ye nas gnyis med mnyamapa'i dal:gnas g.yo byang chub sems nyid la:la mo'i mchog khyod bzhugs su gsol:sa ma ya s+t+waṃ phyag 'tshal ni na mo mthong ba'i yid 'phrog pad+ma'i zhal skom pa'i gdungs

zhi bdud rtsi'i gter: dran pa'i bde stong rtogs pa 'bar: ṭāk+ki'i rje mo khyod phyag 'tshal: sa ma ya na mo ho: mchodapa na hrī: ting 'jin rol mtshor 'khrungs pa'i nor: snang stong zunga'ajug mchod pa'i sprin grags stong rol mo glu dang tshig: gsal stong zhu bde byang sems skyems: reg stong dga' bzhi phyag rgya'i gzugs: dran stong shar grol sgrol mchod mchog rig stong ye shes mkha' 'gror 'bul: ma rig gzhi la sangs ba dang chos dbyings rig pa gcer mthong stsol bla ma hā su kha phyu dza sarba sa ma ya ho bstodapa na hrī rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa'i dbyings ye shes phyag rgya bde ba'i gzugs: rdo rje phag mo 'dzum pa'i zhal: pad+ma'i dgyes sde mchog la bstod: masang bas yid 'phrog mtshan dpe'i zhal thos pas rnal grol brda chos 'byed: dran pas bde chen ye shes stsol: mkhar chen grub pa'i rgyal mor bstod: thogs med phrin las nus mthu grub: zab gter phan bde spel ba'igrogs: dwangs ma 'od skur byang chub pa: rje mo mtsho rgyal nyid la bstod: lha mo'i mchog khyod pad+ma'i lcam: dran pa'i mod la skom pa'i gdung: zla zhal bdag blo'i

——1 pad mtshor ngoms rnams pa kun tu 'bral med shog: 'jig rten mi mo'i tshul gyis ni: sa lam myur bde'i shing rtar drangs bde nas bde ba'i rtser son te: mkha' spyod gling dbus spyod par shog: bdag mthong mdzub reg sgo sbyor ba: mkha' 'gro mi dang sha za mo: kun kyang ma khyod bde stong gzis: btsan thabs dpal rir 'god par shog 'dzab ni hrī: kun tu bzang mo dbyings kyi mkha': kun tu snyoms dang 'dod pa mo'i: bskul te shes rab rtags bskyon nas: ye shes lnga yi dbyings kun khyab mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'dredar ma: rigs sngags zhing skyes nye 'du'i gnas: ṭāk+ki 'dus pa'i gsang mdzod la sku yis rdul tshogs g.ya' dang bral: gsung gi bde ba chen po bskul: thugs kyi phrin las chags 11gas bral phosten 31ngas rang 11la dbo/ngas pa'i ngang: sbyor ba gzhi dang ldan yas rtsa rlu zig le'i bag chags sbyangs sku gsung thugs su smin byed cing dbyings gsum mkha' 'gro'i phran las bskul sa ma yu sgruba'adzab ni hrī: bde ba'i rang bzhin bcom ldan 'das shes rab ye shes me yis bskul: 'khor lo lnga yi he ru ga: dpa' bo dpa' mo rnam 'byor ma: kun kyang dga' bzhi'i

'dzab mchod 'bul: stong nyid 'od gsal mchog tu 'bar: ma dag sgyu lus khams rnams dag: grol ba ye shes dbang bzhis smin: rig 'dzin bzhi yi sa lam rdzogs: thams cad bde chen ye shes ngang: rlung gis re re gtum mo sbar nam mkha'i rdo rje byang chub sems ye shesa'akhor lor phrin lasa'adzug rgyud lnga'i bag chags mtshan ma bsreg zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin spro sku gsum lhun grub dgongs nyams skyo sa sa ma yu las sbyor ni trī: stong chen dbyings kyi mkha' klong du rgyang zhags 'od kyi thig le bsre: shes rig ma bcos thad gar bzhag ye shes chen po'i rlung sbyor gyis: rab 'byams phrin las lhun gyis grub srid dang zhi ba'i stong sgog 'phrog thams cad mnyam nyid chos sku'i ngang rtsol med rlung ni bde bar 'khyil shes pa ka dag mkha' la bzhag rang sar gnas pa 'i rlung sbyor 'dis ye shes chen po khung nas 'bar sa ma yu dngos gzhi'i bskyed rdzogs so rgya rgya rgya tshogs byin rlabs ni ho: bde ba'i snod mchog ka pā lar: blang dor bral ba'i dam tshig rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi che ba'i mchog dpa' bo yab yum dgyes ston spro oṃ u hūṃ ho spyan 'dren na hrī: yulani o rgyan mkha' sgod yul: gnas ni d+ma ma tha la'i klong: zhing ni shin tu nye ba

—14 can: gsang ba mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling: phun tshogs lnga ldan gzhal yas nas: sangs rgyas pad+ma'i dgyes bskyed dbyings: rgyal ba kun yumarnal 'phyor ma dpa'abo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: 'du ba chen po'i mgron la bshegs cing te' drel bu'i sgra la dgongs:rdo rje'i glu gar bro la rol: sngags kyi lta spyod nye bar bzhes nyams pasems kyi bshags lags na: sgrib bral rig pa'i sgron me sbor nang dbyings sku gsum mkha' 'gro yis mi 'gyur gsang mdzod da stsol cig oṃ pad+mo yo kai ni dzñā na sa ra bye e rali hrīng hrīng pho phernyi tshogasamachod ni ho rol pa chen po'i dgyes ston 'di: bde chen dga' bzhi'i mchod pa che: lhan skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gror 'bul sgyu lus 'od gsal dngos grub stsol: ma ma hā ga ṇa cakra pū dza khā hi: bar ༅gas ni ho ye shes mkha' 'gro nye bar dgongs: bdag rmongs ma rig dbang gyur te: lta ba dman zhing rtog pa rtsing: tha mal rang khar 'khrul ba bshags: sa ma yā a: bsgral ba ni trī: lhag mthong rig pa'i mtshon chen byis: rtogs pa'i 'gal zla ma rig pa bdag med chen por rab bsgral te: 'khrul ba

ka nas dag par mdzod: sarba rū tra mā ra ya phaṭa: bstabs pa ni hrī: stong chen phyag rgya'i mkha' 1nga du: ma rtog log rtog 'khrul ba'i bdud: sgyu ma lta bur bsgral ba'i rdzas don dam bden pa rtogs phyir bzhes: du tra ma hā su kha kha re khā hi tshogasal rol ba ni hoḥ 'di ni mtshan ma dag pa'i rdzas sngags kyi dngos grub sbyin pa'i thabs: dga' bzhi'i rol ston bla na med yang dag ye shes nyid du rol a la la ho: lhagam ni pheni skye med mkha' la brten bcas nas: ye shes rjes su 'jug pa can: legs nyes ltong srog 'dzin pa mo ma sringadabang phyug ging la sa: pham phab bzhes la phrin las sgrubs: rnal 'byor sgyu lus zhu bde'i mes dwangs ma 'od skur smin grol mdzod: tshe ma ma hrīngasnga lta bā lirnya khā hi: bskul ba ni bye: bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i lha: bskyod cig mkha' spyod dbyings nas bskul: brtan g.yos rgud pa mtha' dag sol rtsa rlung dbang thang nyams pa gsos bde stong ye shes rtogs pa sbor sgrub 'bras ma g.yel 'byung bar mdzod phathoni hrī rang snang rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing: zung 'jug sprul sku'i gzhal yas su pad ma'i rigs kun

—12 'dus zhal rjes dbang chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la: dgongs pa'i ring bsrel rgyas btab tshe: rig rtsal dpa' bo ging lang ga'i: ro mnyam gtor ma blang nas su/rgyal tshab rig 'dzin gtsug bkur zhing: zab gter bstan pa srung ba dang: mdzad phrin gdul zhing yongs la spel: 'brel tshad dpal ril 'god do zhes: g.yar dam gnyan po cibazhin tu: chad kyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bzhed don yongs grub mdzod: brtan ma ni hṝ pad+ma'i rgyal tshab sprul sku yis: phun tshogs gter gyi gzhi bzung nas: bshadadang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsug la klu gnod sbyin rigs ngan mor zhu bde mchog gi dam rgyas btab: gnas g.yo byang chub sems nyid la brten cing 'brel ba'i mkha' 'grornams: 'bar ba'i bde ba mchog gang des/ phyi nang gsang ba'i 'byung khams kyis: zag pa kun zhi ye shes kyi: mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug thob: de la nye rgyu'i spyod pacan: brtan ma ya ma skyongs ma'i tshogasaX bshal chu'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'jig rten khams kun bde ba dang: 'bar ba'i phrin las rgyas par mdzod rtabrori dhi nye 'khrul

rjes chags rta glu'i 'dul ma rig rū tra bro yis bcom: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma gar gyi bsgyur: ye shes dbyings su bsre bar bya 76āḥ hūṃswā hā s+t+waṃ bha ya nan nan: dngos grub ni ho mkha' 'gro bsgrub pa'i dam tshig thim: dngos grub stsol len dus bab pas mi gnas thugs kyi klong yangs nas bde stong ye shes sgron me sbor: dga' bzhi'i drangs ba'i dbangadangos grub: sa lam sku dang ye shes zhal: rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i dgongs 1nga sbyor: 'pho chen 'ja' lus dngos grub stsol sirnyi phal a la la ho: bzod gsol ni ho ma dag las rlung sems rtog gis nyon mongs rang mtshan gol ba'i nong sor byang sngags sdoms dang 'gal skyon ting 'dzin ma gsal rmongs sgrib bshags: sa ma yā: bsngo ba ni ho yeshes mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma bde ba chen por bsgrub pa'i dges nyon mongs dbang 'khrul cha ma rnams rang rig ye shes rtogs par shog: smonalam ni ho snang sred dag pa mkha' sprod zhing rang rig 'byur med rnal 'byor ma: rnam kun mchog ldan don gyi yum: kun tu bzang mor byang chub shog: bsdurem ni ho thams cad ma 'gags rol ba'i rgyan

(6 rten 'brel gzugs sku'i bkod pa kun: rim bsdu ka dag de bzhin nyid: spros bral nam mkha' lta bur bzhag a āḥ laraldang ni u stong chen dmigs su med pa (17 bsam brjod bral ba'i 'od gsal rgyun: mkha' las gleg 'khyugs ci bzhin tu: rjes thob sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar ldang: phaṭa phaṭa: shis brjod ni na re bde mchog ka dag nam mkha' la: dga' bzhi'i 'od gsal char rgyun 'bebs: dad ldan nyams rtogs myu gu smin: bde sbyin ma khyod shes pa stsol: lta ba mtha' bral rdo rje'i rdzong: blo bral sgom pas sa pam brgal: ro mnyam spyod pas stong srog 'phrogs lhun grub 'bras bu'i shes pa stsol: dngos grub dwangs ma bdud rtsi grub 'khor 'das mnyam nyid rtogs pa mtho rig stong pe shig grub mtha' mjal: a ti rtogs pa'i shes pa (6pa: rjes kyi rim pa'o sa ma yā yim 'pho chen dwangs ma'i skur bzhed pa sa sa rgyas gnyas pa pad 'byung gis dgong sa bdo snyan rgyud man ngag bcud rgyags sras rgyal ba mtshog dbyangs dang zhal mi gnyis pa gang de la mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod pha nor 'phrad de tshe smon lam 'phro btsan pas chosakyi rdo rdzebaskal ba bzang dpal gyi rdo rje rtogs pa mtho shesarab dbang phyug snyang

rje' phyug ye shesabazang mo sbob pa mtho chosakyi rgyal mtshan blo gros rgyas kun bzang tshe ring dad mosache rat+na sar bsod nams ldan rigasamatshog lnga dang gzung ma des bskal ba bzang por phun sum tshogs sgod min la ni phyag rgyas sdom rig pa 'dzin pa'i pad tshal smin don gnyisalhun gyi grub gyur cig nga sprul dang mi gzhan pas dpa' bo gcig dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi

——1 dgasnang lasaḥ mkha' 'gro dgyesaba'i tshogs bsdus na dum gcig stod du bza' nas rigs bsags la sbyangs bsgyur spel byas te hrī: lhan skyes dhu ma tha la'i grong khyer nas: bde ba'i rtser son rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: 'bar bzhu'i dam tshig 'du ba tshogs la byon: dga' bzhi'i tshogs 'bul rlung sems dhu tir bshags: chags pa rab bsgral 'od gsal dgongs klong bstabs: 'khrul ba ka dag nang dbyings dwangs ma'i sbubs: bde sbyin mkha' spyod gsang gsum mngon gyur regag: grangs bsogs tshogs rdzogs nyams rtogs 'phel don gnyis lhun grubagadon mi za sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya brda zim snyi rat+na sa ras chos kyi skal ba'o stag mo'i yang rdzong nas spel ba dge

—— dag snang las: bshags pa sgrib bral me longs bzhugs so:snarmasgo 17 mkha' mnyam bde ba chen po'i klong la phyag 'tshal lo kun nas rang bzhin spros dang bral mod kyang: rol ba 'gags med rtsa rlung thig le'i khams: kun gzhi'i rnam shes nyid las yongs mched pa: bcing grol med pa chos kyi dbyings su bshags: rig cha bral ba'i las rlung g.yo ba can: 'gyu cha dben pa'i sems nyid rmun 'thum po: zung du 'jug pa kun rtog 'khor ba'i rgyu: rlung sems dbu ma dgra gcan dbyings su bshags: phyi nang rlung bcu las su ma rung te: g.yo spyod rtog pa yul gyi bzhon gyur ba'i 'gyu ba chechung phra rag ci snyed kun: 'gyur med thig le ye shes rlung lngar bshags: chos nyid mnyam pa'i rtsa khams rlung gi 'gros: gdangs snang kun tu gzhi yi rnam shes bcas: sku yi gsangab rdo rjer ma chun pa: gnas kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i spyan sngar bshags: ye shes kyi ni rtsa khams rlung gi 'gro'i gdangs snang yid shes bag chags snang ba bcas bde mchog

budha'i rig rtsal ma rdzogs pa he ru'i gnas bcas dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bshags: yon tan gyi ni rtsa khams rlung gi 'gros gdangs 'od sgo lnga'i rnam shes snang char bcas yon tan phrin las nyid du ma rdzogs pa dur khrod brgyad bzhugs dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bshags: rang rgyud kyi ni rtsa khams rlung gi 'gros gdangs mdangs nyon mongs yid can bag chags bcas: bde chen pad+ma'i rigs su ma bskyil ba yul la spyod pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bshags yang dag don gyi rtsa khams rlung gi 'gros dhu ma tha la o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling: sku gsum ye shes ḍak+ki'i gsang ba che phyogs ris gol sgrib rtogs 'khrul gnyis snang bshags: stong chen dbu ma mtha' bral chen po'i klong shes rab srog ldan rnam kun mchog ldan dbyings bde ba kun gyi mchog gsang ma chen zhal lkog gyur bag chags dri ma bshags bgyi'o: ka ti 'od kyi gzhal med khang chen klong thig le'i sku mchog rig pa'i snying po can: stong gsal mdangs lnga ldan pa ma chen zhal mngon du ma gyur shes sgrib dri ma bshags: gdangs kyi snang ba shes rab khongs su sangs

tshaX mdangs snang bkod pa ye shes nyed du dag: nang dbyengs gteng gsal ches kye sku ru sad: rgya grol khyab brdal kun tu bzang rma'i klong: dza lta dz+wa snyed ye shes bla ma'e /de cherdogs pa chen po'i chos sku ka dag ngang a ā: de ltar bshags pa 'i rlu sems kya kun rmongs ma rag dra ma 'dag klong rdol rtogs pa mkha' ltar rgyas:don gnyis lhun grub ze mi tshom sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi las can rat+na sa ras chos skal ste 'gro phan phrin las bsam mtha' yas gyur cig sarba maṅga zug/

dpa dag snang lasajas bskang dga' bzhi'i rol ston bzhugs:rgathazla hrī: chos dbyings nam mkha'i skong bu rtsa 'od gsal thig le'i mar khur gtams rdo rje lug rgyud sgron me sbar: nang dbyings mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs stong gsal sems kyi bhan+ta nas bsam gtan blo 'das rak+tas bkang bde stong zung 'jug chags pas bskyed: lhan skyes mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: cit+ta 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong du dkar 'jams rtsa yi dpal bshos btsug: sgron ma mig gi brgyan gyis spras: gdangs gsal mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: kun gzhi 1nga yangs bhan+ta ru byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang: shar grol zang thal zeg ma 'khrigs: ye grol mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: gsang ba bde skyongs rdo rje'i snod: 'bar ba'i zhu bde'i dza gad gtams: dga' bzhi'i 'od gsal zlos gar bsgyuraḥ dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs phyag rgya sngags kyis ma bsnyen zhing: shes rab ma la gshe bskur rtsod

bug rdol skyon gyis gos pa rnams: 'da' dka' ye shes mkha' 'gror bshags: dam tshig chags nyams rang grol te: sgyu lus zhu bde'i me yis tshim: bde ba chen po mngon gyur nas: he ru ka dpal mchog thob regag dam tshag chags nyamasarang grol te ma dang mkha' 'gro'i sras su 'gyur sa ma ga rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zim snyi rat+na sarasachosaskal lo sarba ma lam/

—9 snyan brgyud rin po che'i mdzod las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa sgrub bde stong kha sbyor bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na ḍak+ki ni ya: za1rna〈pertenajo| ma dag las rlung phyir bsal nas ye shes rlung bcud lan brgyar len bde stong gtum mo 'bar 'dzag sgoms sgyu lus lha ru gsal gdab pa sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed na na mo: rgyal ba kun yum shes rab pha rol phyin: rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la skyabs su mchi: las nyon gnyid kyi myos pa'i 'gro ba rnams bde chen sa la 'god byir sems bskyed do:lan gsum gnyis pa la bskyed bsgom pa ni a bde chen ye shes rang gzugs mkha' 'gro'i gling: o rgyan dh+wak+ki nye 'du mdzad pa'i yul: rat+na mdzes pa'i gzhal med khaṃ dbus su: chu skyes ge sar nyi zla bzhad pa'i khar: bde chen rgyal ba dgyes mdzad dhāk+ki'i gtso: mtsho rgyal dmar mo bcu drug lang tshos 'khyud: phyag g.yas cang te'u snyan gyi thad gar 'khrol dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba rgyas par byed: g.yon pas gri gug dku la brten cing 'gyeng: dpa' bo'i rang bzhin bde la mnyam par rol: rus rgyan dar dpyangs pad+ma'i do shal

mdzes: gcer mo dor stabs pad+mo 'o 'dzin 'bus: rat+na'i ku mud thod gdengs cod paṇa mdzes: spyan zung dkyus ring chos dbyings mkha' la rol: rigs bdag a tsarugazhon dkar gsal 'dzum: he ru ka pa'i snang stong cing til 'brol: 'ja' 'od klong 'bying brgyud gsum byin rlabs rdzogs: kun dhar ma dbyings chos sku'i 'du ba rgyas: ro ma chen mor sprul sku'i spro bsdu 'byed: rkyang ma dkar mo longs sku'i mdzad phrin g.yo: chos nyid mnyam par gnas kyi rnal 'byor ma: 'od zer zlum la rdo rje'i rigs kun 'khyil: ye shes dwangs mar he ru ka gnas 'du: 'od mthing dkyus mar budha'i rigs rnams 'tshogs rang rgyud rtsa gnas yul gyi —k+ki gnas: 'od dmar zla gam pad+ma'i rigs kun bde: yon tan rtsa khams dur khrod mkha' 'gro 'gyed: 'od dmar nag la yon tan phrin las rigs: thams cad ma lus lhun grub bde ba che: dwangs ma lnga 'dus khams kyi dkyil 'khor che sra ba'i dbyings kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro brten: dwangs shing gsher bas thams cad mnyam par bskul: 'bar bskyod las kyis gdul bya sgron me sbar: yangs shing g.yo bas phrin las

—11 kun la 'jug: khyab cing brdal ba'i mkha' spyod mngon du byed: nam mkha'i gzugs can ye shes thig le che: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du lhun gyis grub: sgog gi dwangs ma mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i mdzod: dbyings dang 'jig rten sha za lhun gyis grubaḥ dam tshag dag pa'i de don bsnyen sgrub na: o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling nas ḍak+ka'i tshogs:dkyus rang spyan g.yos 'dzum pa'i bā da dri ngoms: bde ba'i dkyil 'khor ba sbu gzing slong ngoms: chags pa'i dpa' rtogs bcu drug gzhon nu bskul: mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba'i tshang 'od 'khrigs: srid las rnam grol bde stong sgyu lus 'byung: sbyor ba lnga ldan 'dzag med phrin las kyis: 'khor lo lnga bskul rgyud lnga'i gnas stongs shing: ye shes lnga yilta dgongs mngon gyur dmigs ting 'dzin mi 'gyur bstan po yis rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'asdug pa nyid rngub dgang dkyil 'phen phran las kyis sbyor ba bzhi lngan 'dzab rgyun skyongs des mi nyams rtogs mkha' ltar rgyas nyon mo sa las kyi rba klong skems bde sto zung 'asngug rtogs pa rgyas the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yu gsum pa mchod cing bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī: bde ba mchog sbyin lha mo yid 'ong mar: phyi nang gsang ba'i

dga' ston bde mnyam sbyar: gnyis med mnyam pa chen por rtags rol nas ye shes thugs gnas thig le'i bde ba stsol: o ma hā a nu ra ga pū dza sa ma ya ho trī mthong ba'i yid 'phrog mtshan dpe'i zhal bzang ngoms: thos pa'i rnam grol 'gags med brda chos 'gyed: dran pas srid zhi'i 'jigs 'phrog bde chen bskyed: pad+ma'i lcam gcig rnal 'byor ma la bstod 'di ni nye lam kun gyi yul tshe 'dir las nyon zag pa zad bde chen ye shes grong nas 'char 'og min mkha' la spyod par 'gyur sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya bdo thim lha zhes pa'ang rat+na sa ra'i chos la ste snying nor sto dhi bha dra'i bzhed ngor sngagasalas nu ldanardo rje'i shar mar spel ba sarba ma lam

—13 dag snang las: dbyings kyi rje mo'i bskang gsol phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so:na mo gu ru la: tsar+sharten bh+yo chos dbyings mkha' ltar dag pa'i klong yangs su: rnam kun mchog ldan sgyu 'phrulaye ka dza stong pa nam mkha'i gzugs can bzod dka'i nyam nyag gcig gzigs pa g.yu ral 'bru gcig spud: rtogs med zhing dbyugs nyams pa'i don snying 'byin: sprin thul ku mud phreng ba 'ja' 'od 'khyugs: bde dang stong pa'i 'o rgyun chu 'dzin ngoms 'phrul gshogs rlung gi rkang pa stobs shugs me: zer ngar tshwa tshwa rdo rje'i sprin thogs 'bebs: dga' bzhi'i dpal ster pād zla nyi steng rol: 'dzum pa'i dpal mdangs 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro 'gyed: bka' nyan las byed ngan ne+e ma bzhi yis: bstan pa srung zhing de 'dzin 'dus sde spel: kun kyang dam sgog rdo rje'i sa bon las: spros pa'i 'od kyis dbyings bzhugs spyan drangs bstims: spos bsregs rol mo'i sgras spyan dra sa ba mi: bye mi gnas rmi dmigs chos kyi dbyings nyid las: bde stong dpal sbyin a ti'i gsang

'dzin ma: 'bum phrag rgyud kyi bdag mo e ka dza: sgyu 'phrul 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol sa ma mo yinaka dza ṭī sarba sa ma ya dza dza bzhugasagasol ni dza: dam tshog dag pa gsang ba'i bla rdo dang: tha snyad rten rdzas srog gi 'khor lo la: dbyer med brtan bzhugs phrin las rab 'byams kun thog pa med pa yid bzhin 'byung bar mdzod sarba sa ma ya tisgo lhan phyag la ba ni na mo ma skyes bajod bral bde ba kun gyi gsang: snying po ye shes skyongs ba'i dam 'dzin ma: dbyings kyi yum mchog e ka dza ṭī la: brda yimatshan nas gar bcas phyag bgyi'o: sa ma ya na mo ho: mchodapa ni hūṃ trī: dbang yul shes ngor shar b.limachod sprin ni: phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang de kho na: sngags ston dza gad myong grol a mṛ ta: bde sbyor dmar chen brten sgrub mchod bskang rdzas thugs mthun yo byad nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa: ma tshang med pa ting 'dzin rol pa'i rgyan: 'di na yongs dag dga' ston phun tshogs bkod ma chen dbyings kyi rje mo gsol mchod bskangs: dpal ldan a phyi chen mo dam ldan yang phyi chen mo gsol mchod bskangs: sngags

7/ bdag smug nag 'od 'phro ma chen e ka dza ṭi sprul pa yang sprul mu med gsol mchod bskangs:khyed nyid dgyes shing tshims pa'i mdangs ngoms la:rnam mang phrin /dī lhun gyis grub pa dang: phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub char ltar phob: mchog tu mi 'gyur bde stong rtogs pa spor:sgyu lus 'od gsal dwangs mar smin pa dang 'ja' lus 'pho chen sa la skyel ma mdzod:31 ma ma e ka da ṭī sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra aste sogs bha rū pa sogs spar she ma hā pañtsa rak+ta bha lirte kha kha khā hi khā hi bstod pa ni bye skye med dbyings kyi yum chen e ka dza rgyal ba kun yum bde chen skyed pa'i ma:brgyud gsum mdzod 'dzin sa lam brdas ston pa'i:ma chen dbyings kyi rje mor phyag 'tshal bstod:skye med dbyings las sna tshogs thabs mang pos: sbyor sgrol mdzad ston sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs:nyes med 'gro ba skyongs ba'i dam tshig can:gtso 'khor sprul par bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod 'di bzung ji srid chos sku mngon gyur bar: ma chen khyed kyi 'bral med rjes bzung nas: sa lam nyams rtogs yar zla ltar 'phel zhing:tshe 'dir 'od phung grub pa'i grogs mdzod

cig bshags pa ni he brtse ldan sngags kyi dbang mo bdag la dgongs gsang chen sgor zhugs dam las 'gal ba dang cho ga lhag chad ting 'dzin bying rmug 'thibs: thugasa'agal nong pa bshags so bzod par bzhes: sa ma ya yis de ltar sgrub pa'i snying nye zhing phrin las lhun gyisagrub par 'gyur sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim thi lasaldan rat+na sa ra'i bgo skal ste ngomatshar zhing bzang smin pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba masgo lam

༈ sngags srung ma' gsol mchod ni bye ma skyes mi 'gags chos kyi dbyings nyid las kun bzang rol pa bde stonga.e ka dza: dad pas 'bod do dam tshig rten la bzhugs brda yiphyag spro gar gyis bstod par bgyi: 'gags med rig pa'i rgyan mchod 'bul gyi bzhes: gol sa tshar gcod rtogs pa'i sgron me sbor: sgyu lus 'od sku 'grub pa'i brin las mdzod bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma pā: grangs bsogs snying nye phrin las myur lus dang grib bzhin 'bral med 'grogs sa lam nyams rtogs rabs spel zhi sgyu lus 'od skur smin par byed sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya brda thim 31 las ldan rat+na sa ris chos kyi skal ba maṅka lam/

༈ sngags kyi bdag mo'i 'byugs bskang ni bh+yo: dbyings nyid ka dag ye shes lhun grub kyang: ma rig dbang gis sdom gsum bslab dam nyams: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i thugs 'gal nongs pa bshags: 'khrugs pa sor chud changs pa'i dngos grub stsol: de ltar bskang bas 'khrugs pa zha ma dang bu bzhin srung bar nges sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi rat+na sa ris chos kyis skal ba ste bkra shis par gyur cig sarba maṅga lam/

—12 gsol bsdus na bh+yo kun tu bzang mo dbyings kyi yum: e ka dza ṭi gsol mchod bskang: gting gsal rig pa'i zhal ston la 'od skur grol ba'i phrin las mdzod grangs bsogs snying nye phrin las myur sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya rat+na sa ris chos kyi skal ba'o sarba masgo lam

dag snang las mkha' 'gro'idagyes bskang yid bzhin sprin gyi phung po bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na sa ra phyo: tsun11pho1cas ( brtan g.yos dpal 'byor ma lus pa ye shes rig pas dang blang nas lhan skyes dpa 'a bo mkha' 'gro rnams dgyes pa bskang ba'i sprin du spel sa ma yu hūṃ hrī lnga ldan zang mdog dpal gyi ri: sgyu lus 'od gsal pho brang nas: mi 'gyur bde ba mchog sbyin pa'i lhan skyes ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas 'du ba chen po'i dga' ston la: brtse ba'i zur mig g.yo bzhin du: zhu bde sbar bzhin gshegs su gsol: snang ba 'ja' dang 'od kyis gang: dngos kun ye shes bdud rtsir shar: 'gyu ba dpa' bo' bro ra 'byugs: gnas pa dpa' mo'i rtse gar bsgyur: g.yo ba nam mkhar rdo rje'i ging: 'bar ba rgya mtsho mkha' 'gro ma: 'khor lo lnga la gnas dang yul: dur khrod he ru'i bde mchog bkod: dga' dang stong pa'i 'od gsal gyis bud+dha rigs kyi dpa' bo dang: mkha' 'gro dang ni rnal 'byor ma: rigs sngags zhing skyes thugs dam bskang mchog

dga' stong chen 'od gsal gyi:pad+ma'i rigs kun chags pa bral:bde sbyin dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thabs shes gnyis med thugs dam bskang:khyad dga' thams cad stong pa yis:rdo rje'i rang bzhin bde ba che mi rtogs snying rjes cha 'dzin pa'i:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang:lhan skyes shin tu stong pa yis:mi gnas mi dmigs mnyam pa nyid:yon tan rin chen rigs grub gter:dkar dmar cha 'dzin thugs dam bskang dga' bral rnam kun mchog ldan pas:khyab pa chen po thig le'i dpyid:ye shes snyoms pa bde ba'i mchog:dga' ster yab yum thugs dam bskang:bol+la gak+ko bsre sbyor gyis:mkha' khyabs byang chub sems kyi sprin:gnyis ga nyer rgyu'i spyod pa yis:he ru ka dpal thugs dam bskang:khams gsum rol ba bde ba'i mchog:'du shes gsum ldan dam tshig dag:rim pa gsum gang thabs mkhas lam:mnyam sbyor dgongs pas thugs dam bskang:a la la ho bde ba che:sngags kyi dngos grub mu tra'i gsang:rgyu ni sems can rang bzhin las:'bras bu sangs rgyas rted gyur cig:bde ba las byung dga' ba des

pa ra sems can khams ni rnam dag byed rgyu la brten pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma tshogs mnyes pa las sems kyi chags nyams sor chud cing rtogs pa'i yon tan mchog dang ldan 'bar ba zhu bde'i las byung bas rte (dro 'od gsal sku 'grub so sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda tham snyi las can gcig da 'phrad par shog maṇ+ḍal hi bam rat+na sa ra'i chos kya skal ba ste bkra shis bar gyur cig sarba masgo lamaḥ

—13 dag snang las: gnas yul mkha' 'gra'i bskang ba ni hrī: o rgyan mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling: nyi shu rtsa bzhi yul so gnyis: he ru'i gnas bcu dur khrod brgyad: phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi: 'brel ba'i gnas mchog thams cad nas dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma: rigs sngags zhing skyes tshogs rnams kun: 'du ba chen po'i rol ston la: bde stongadaga' bzhi'i 'jum bcas byen: sngags tshig glu dang gar la rol: 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs la spyod: tshim pa drug ldan zlos gar bsgyur dam tshig nyams chags bzod gsol bzhes: rnal 'byer tshe bsod nyams rtogs spel: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bu bzhin skyongs rgyu lus zhu bde'i me yis sbyangs: 'od gsal dwangs ma'i 'khor lor sad: rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i sa la sbyor rjes chags mdzad pa sa 'gro phan grub don gnyis 'byung ba'i grogs mdzod cig: de ltar phul ba'i tshogs chen rdzogs dpa 'a bo mkha' 'gro'i bu bzhin skyongs thabs mang dka' ba med pa 'di skal ba can gyi dpal du shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ye brda thim snyi rat+na sa ras bgo skal lags soḥ

——1 dag snang las: 'chi bslu 'chi bdag g.yul bzlog bzhugs:na 31 dzñā na ṭāk+ki ni ya: rwa cadab rdo2)/ srung byas las drag kha snab lud skra sen bsres pa 'i sku glud mi mthi dkar ser dmar ljang gu bya cha glud theb skyu lo gra sa byed nam mkha' ma da' 'phang glud rdzas bkrams 'byusna ja mar sha dum bsags rang nyad mkha' 'gros tang 'dzan gyis na mo chos nyid ye stong ka dag dang: kun rdzob rgyu 'bras baspu med mthu: sngags dang ting 'dzan bden pa'i stobs: skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs kyis: med snang stong gzugs 'khrul ba'i gdon: sgyu 'phrul ltad mo bkod la 'dus: tri a ra ya dza tshuka baṃ ho: lan bdun nam dgu brjod byin rlabs ni trī: mi srid dgu 'phrul srid pa'i mdos: ting 'dzin nam mkha' mdzod kyi dkor lha 'dre'i yid spyod skong ba'i rdzas: ngo mtshar ltad mo phun tshogs gyur: ma āḥhūṃ: sngags dang phyag rgyasazad med spel spyan 'dren ni kye mtho ste chos dbyings nam mkha'i klong: dma' ste rin chen gser gyi gzhi: yangs ba gling bzhi srid pa'i dkor: mi zad mdos la da tshur byon: rin

chen dkor nor phun sum tshogs:'dod pa'i yon tan lhun gyi grub:'phrul gyis srog chags ya mtshan can:bkod mdzes mdos la gzigs shig bzhugs:sems la gang 'dodade ltar snang yid la re smon chags thogs bral:mtho dman ngo srung med par mnyam nam mkha' mdzod la gus phyag 'tshal:zhi zhing byams sems ldan par gyis:snyen badz+ra sa mnadza hūṃ dza:mdos mchod na kyi:stong pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las:gnam mtha' lcags kyi thabs chen dang:sa mtha' zangs kyi shes rab mas:'phrul gyi thog ma gdon chen lnga:de las gyes pa brgyad cu dang gzhan yang khri brgyad bzhi stong ste:nyon mongs las las skyes pa rnams:tshogs yul rang grol glud gtor 'dis ngom shing tshim nas grol gyur cig kun gzhi'i gnyid kyis myos gyur te:chos dbyings ye shes ma rtogs pas gti mug rmong pa'i bgegs rigs rnams:nam mkha'i rang mdangs glud gtor 'dis:ngom shing tshim nas grol gyur cig: nyon mongs yid kyi dbang gyur te: mnyam nyid ye shes ma rtogs pas: nga rgyal rgyas pa'i bgegs rigs rnams sa khams 'dzin med glud

dzeX 'ator 'dis ngom shing tshim nas grol gyur cig: phra gsal rnam shes kyis 'ching ste: me long ye shes ma rtogs pas zhe sdang 'khrugs pa'i lha 'dre rnams chu khamasa'ar+shar+shas med glud gtor 'dis: ngom shing tshim nas grol gyur cig: dwangs gsal yid la bdag bzung te sor rtogs ye shes ma rtogs pas: 'dod chags 'tshubs ma'i gdon bgegs rnams: me khams 'bar g.yos glud gtor 'dis: ngom shing tshim nas grol gyur cig: las rlung 'jin pa a 'thas te: bya grub ye shes ma rtogs pas: phrag dogs 'tshubs pa'i gdon bgegs rnams: rlung khams 'gags med glud gtor 'dis: ngom shing tshim nas grol gyur cig: rigs kyi dkyil nasar ma rtogs te phung po lnga la bdag bzung bas: rten 'brel las gyur bgegs rigs rnams lugs 'byung sgyu ma'i glud gtor 'dis: ngom shing tshim nas grol gyur cig: saṃ bha ras sngags ci rigs brjod la glud gtor bsngo skye med dbyings las shar ba yis: 'gags med sgyu mas glud gtor 'dis: zhen med rang ngo rtogs mdzod la: 'khrul med rgyal ba'i rjes su snyogs: saṃ rgya ras sngags brjod la glud bsngo

lam bstan pa ni kye: rang snang log par 'khrul ba'i gdon ma rig dbang gyur lha 'dre rnams: sgyu ma'i nor gyi mgu byos la: chos dbyings stong pa'i klong du gshegs: skye 'chi'i bdag 'dzin mtshan ma bor: stong nyid snying rje'i ngang la gnas: so so rang rig rgyal ba'i yum don dam rtogs mdzod glud mgron rnams: 'khor ba 'das pa'i pha rol phyin: grolaba'i shul lam zin par gyis: 'di ru ma 'dug rang sar dengs: / hūṃ༄sna tsu ta ya phaṭa: ces brjod glud gtor lo bdud phyogs su bskyal phya nang tshe yi bar chad 'ad yis sel sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya gu gye bdotham 3/ zhes pa 'di'ang nus ldan pas so dge'o sarba maṅga lam

sum̐: snyan rgyudarin po che'i mdzod las mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i thabs mchog sreg jugs phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so:na mo dzñā na ḍāk+ki ni yā: 14)khri bsreg dkyil rdzas rnamasagazhung ltar bsags thab khang lhun grub 'bar me rlu pa nga kheb thod chi sa kun kya bsgrub las chu rdo dril dam tshig 'ari na sa ma yu rdzas byin brlabs ni e:skye med dgongs pa'i gzi byin gyis: dgyes ston bsregs rdzas ma lus pa: ye shes bdud rtsir rab bsgyur te: mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i ltad mor 'phrul: ma ā nyu ha ho hrī: shirnyi puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya pāṭa: mesbar ni ram̐ḥ me ni sor rtog ye shes mad sa: mtshan ma'i rtog sgrib bud shing bsregs: gos dkar chen mo'i dgongs pa yis: dbyings yum ma tshogs dgyes pa bskangs ram̐ badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la ram: lhabaskyed ni sa: mi dmigs ngang las me dpung klong: bde chen dbang gi sprin 'khrigs dbus: pad+ma nyi zla baṃ ro'i steng sa yig mthing ka las spros pa'i: 'od kyi 'khor 'das dpal yon bstims yongs gyur mdun bskyed me yi lha: ma cig las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: mthing gsal zhi 'dzum lang tshos 'khyud: rus

tha 'i rgyan drug rnam par 'chang: phyag gnyis cing te2 dril bu 'khril: zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur kha ṭ+wāṃ bsten: snang stong zung 'ablug gzigs pa ngoms: rig bdag dbyings kyi yuthuzen mo: 'khor du las bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dang: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ma 'dres gsal sgogs gis bskul te 'og min nas: ye shes nims spyan drangs bstims: me dar g.yab cing spyon drangs ni hūṃ trī: 'og min mkha' spyod zhing khams nas: rgyal ba bskyed pa'i dbyings chen mo: ma cig mkha' 'gro gtso 'khor bcajaribar ba'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs sgo dzñā na ḍak+ki ni sa ma ya dza dza bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal na hrī rtog bral ro gdan pad zla'i khar: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas bzhug su gsol: 'bar ba'i brin las grub pa'i phyir sgo gsum gus pas phyag bgyi'o: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ na mo na ma ho mchod pa ni hrī gzung 'dzin spros pa rnam dag pa'i: phyi nang gas thachod rgya mtsho'i sprin ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dal du 'bul: dgyes shing brtse ba'i tshul gyis bzhes: a ma hā pañtsa byu dza ho: byon skyems rtsa jags nyer gcig bca

rnu: mar khu phul: rdzas 'bul ni o āḥshā: ren chen 'jes pa'i snod nang du: gtams pa'i bsregs rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgyun: che ge'i phrin las grub pa'i phyir ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dal du 'bul: rtsa jags mthar dam tshog nyams chags sdig sgrib nyes ltung sarba shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: 'dod gsol ni he ye shes mkha' 'gro dkyil du zhal zas sreg jugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus: rnal 'byer ba bdag cag rnams kyi dam tshig nyams chags sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad zhi ba dang: nad gdon bar chad 'phral rkyen sna tshogs ming tsam yang mi 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: brgya stong sogs skabs bstun 'bul: rtsasngags mthar tshe dpal nyams rtogs ye shes yon tan thams cad puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā: 'dod gsol na ho: yeshes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du zhal zas sreg jugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus: rnal 'byor ba bdag cag rnams kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byer nyams rtogs ye shes yon tan thams tan rgyas pa dang: bstan pa dang der 'dzan sbyin bdag phun sum tshogs pa'i phrin las dam pa stsol cig: skabs dang bstun la ci

lasab brjod rtsa sngags mthar rlung sems ting 'dzin 'khor slob ḍak+ki ma wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: 'dod gsol na ho ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du zhal zas sreg jugs kyi mchod pargya chen po phul la'i mthus: rnal 'byor ba bdag cag rnams kyi rlung sems ting nge 'dzin dbang du gyur pa dang: 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang dang dngos grub malus pa thams cad dus 'dir myur bar stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: skabs dang mthun par ca 'grub brjod rtsa sngags mthar gnod byed dgra bgegs bdud dang dam sri log par lta ba thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa swā hā: 'dod gsol ni ho: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du zhal zas sreg jugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag cag rnams la 'tshe ba'i bdud bgegs dam sri nad gdon rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad bzlog pa dang: skye 'chi gnyis 'dzin gyi spros pa thams cad de bzhin nyid du tshar gcod pa'i phrin las dam pa mdzod cig: skabs dang bstun la ca rigs brjod khyad par las bzhi gang gtso ltar lhar gsal sngags mchod 'dod gsol sbyar lhag ma rnams ni dor kyang rung bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī: rnam kun

—11 'phags ma ku ru kul+le'i phyag rgya 'khor 'das dbang sdud pad+ma'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so:na mo ku rukulce trīḥ zoshākaskyorjenagruzlapho / sbyor ba skyabs sems ni na moḥ blta bas mi ngoms mtshan dpe'i zhal bzang can dran pas bde ster lha mor skyabs su mchiḥ chags pas myos shing srid na dub pa rnams bde chen sa la 'god phyir sems bsgyed doX lan gsum daro sa gzhi bskyed rdzogs niḥ u gzhi snang dag pa bde chen mkha' spyod zhingaḥ ma brtsal rang byung dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sprin ༷ 'od snang 'ja' zer drwa gur 'khrigs pa'i 1ngaX dmar gsal dbang gi 'od khyims 'bum rdzogs dbusaḥ chags bral pad+ma rtog med bam ro'i kharaḥsor rtog ye shes ku ru kusle dmaraḥ 'dzum zhal mtshan dpe'i dpal 'khyud bde chen 'baraḥ phyag bzhi pa d+ma'i mda' gzhu lcags zhags 'dzinaḥ 'khor 'das srid pa'i dpal yon dbang du byedaḥ gar bsgyur zhabs kyis bdud dpung kha lo bsgyuraḥ 'bar ba'i 'od zer dbang gi lcags kyu yis 'khor slob rgyal jon skye dgu'i jo yid 'gugasaḥ thod skam dbu

rgyan dar sna'i cod paṇa mdzesaḥ rus pa'i chas drug stag sham dril g.yer dngaḥ ljang jon dar dpyangs mgo phreng rgyan du 'chang bde ba'i rang bzhin 'bum sprin mkha' 'gro 'khyil srog gis bskul te pad+ma gsung gi dal rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs bstims brtan g.yo ro mnyam ye shes rdo rjer bzhugasaX bde ba chen po'i rang zhal mjal phyag 'tshalaX kun tu chags bral dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul glu tshig gar dang bro yi dgongs pas bstodaḥ rlung gi rjes 'gro rtog gnyis dri ma bshags 'pho med dgongs pas thugs sgog hrīḥyig gcun phrin las drug ldan jags las zer spros te phyin drug mdzad pas 'khor ba dong sprugs dmigasaḥ 31 ku ru kul+le hrīḥ snya nga po 'bum phrag drug tu bzla las jags na a n+ni triḥ.a ma ya bsdus bsdus sirnyi pha la s+t+waṃḥ nyin bzhin brgya brjod dbang sdud cheḥs ma shā rjes rim jags mchod phul bas rjesaḥhrīḥ bde ba kun gyi mthar son stong pa nyidaḥ chos kun 'byung gnas skye 'gags bral ba' mkha' sor rtog ye shes pad+ma dbang gi zhal bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+ler bstodaX tha snyad srid pa'i sgyu lus snang cha rab bor tsheḥ bde sbyin dbyings kyi

—14 phyag rgyas glu gar rol mor bcasaX mkha' spyod dga' ma'i bzhin bzang 'bum ngoms tshogs kyis rjeraḥ myur bar 'god pa'i dam tshig dam pa de stsol mdzodaḥ o ku na kul+le sirnyi hrīḥ 'di 'dra'i gdam zab srid na dkon khab len rdo lta ra dbang sdud che ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud mchog skal ba can gya dpal du shogaḥ sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥ snyiḥ zhes rdul gnas rinachen rdzongs kyi g.yas phyogs rje btsun 'phags ma'i gnas kyi nye 'dabs/ dpal chen phrin las ljong gi sgo drung/ dbang phyug rtse gar bsgyur ba'i thang chen po nas/ kho ponus ldan bdud 'jomasarol ba' rdo rjes bris pa masgo lam/

—13 e ma ma chen pad+ma 'dzum pa'i zhal can dbang gi lcags kyu kun nas g.yo stong khams srid pa'i dpal 'byor be+eḍūr yangs pa'i khyon mnyam ma lus pa 'bar bachen po'i rlabs su dril la sgrub pa po yi dpal du stsolaḥ nga khyod bdag 'dzin dben zhing bstan pa'i zhabs tog grub pa'i rgyur gyur cigaḥ sa ku ru kugle lo ka sarba a la ya bsdusabasdus sidhi pha la s+t+waṃḥ zhes rdul gnas ran po che'i yang dben gya phrin las rdzong nas nusaldan chagasapas rdo rjes bris pa dzan+tu/

—1) ḍāk+ki ma la tshogs mchod 'bul ba bsod nams phung po bzhugs soḥ na mo ku ru ku ru kul+le hrīḥ shastenasidzā tshogs rdzas sna chogasabasags la byan gyis brlabs pa niḥ ho: bde chen snod mchog ka pā lar sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin rdzasaḥ tshogs ston nam mkha'i mtha' klas paḥ mkha' 'gro'i gsang gsum bskang phyir spelaX oṃ āhūṃḥhoḥ tshogs zhing spyan drangs la 'bul bshags bsgral stab niḥ shā hrī rang snang bde chen mkha' 'gro'i zhingaḥ mkha' spyod gling nas dhāki'i tshogasaḥ ku ru kuspe'i rnam pa ru dga' ston tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi'i tshogs ston rol: dgyes pa bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyisaḥ rnal 'byor nyams chags sor chud nas0 tshe dang dbang gi dngos grub stsol: rtogs pas bdag snang chos skur bsgralaḥ thugs rjes gzhan btul gzugs skur bstabasaX dpa' bo mkha' 'gro las la byon bde stong zung 'jug rtogs pa sboraḥ ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu dza khā hiḥ tshogs la rol teḥ alal ho zhes ngo mtshar dang spro ba bskyed do rjes su lhag ma 'bul ba ni phe stong pa'i srog

ldan lhag skyongs tshogs pham phab bzhes la phrin las sgrubaḥ rdo rje'i bka' sdod rgya mtsho dang bod skyongs brtan mas g.yar dam bzhinaX gang brtsam phrin las 'grub pa dang 'ja' lus 'od sku'i grogs mdzod cigaḥ sarba dharmā pa la e rda bha lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi: bgags pa bsngo smon niḥhoḥ sems kyi nong pas sdom gsum dang 'gal 'khrul nyams chags ci mchis bshags sa ma ya u hoḥ 'dus dang 'dus ma byas pa'i dgeX 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngo gdod ma'i grol gzhi mngon gyur te sku dang ye shes mngon gyur shog lan gsum u snang cha rims bsdus chos skur bzhagaḥ rjes thob phyag rgyas gzugs skur spyodaḥ a pāṭa na mo bde stong 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis srid pa'i bag chags kun bcom te: mnyam nyid ye shes 'khor lo sad 'bras bus lhun rdzogs shis pa rtsolaḥ bsod namasathabs su shar ba yaḥ 'jug ngog bla na med pa'oḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu bye brda tham thiḥzhes bla ma mthu dpal sogs kyis bskul ngor/ nus ldan pasaspel ba ma lam/

—14 dag snang las dbang sdud rno ba'i lcags kyu'i g.yang 'bod bzhugs soḥcha'ipo66mirtos 'om mda' dbang ge dar g.yab nas snyan pa'i glu yis 'di skad brngo da slo ku ru kul+le hrīḥ stong gsum gleng bzhi srad pa'i dpa laḥ lha klu mi yi dga' ston gteraḥ 'dod rgu'idapal yon phywa dang g.yangaX thams cad ma lus 'dir khug cig sgyu lus dngas mar smin pa'i phyiraḥ bde stong phyag rgya'i phywa g.yang khugaḥ chos mthun bsam pa 'grub pa'i phyiraḥ 'tshob zas kyi phywa g.yang stsolaX gzhan snang dge la sbyor ba'i phyiraḥ gdul bya mdzad phrin phywa g.yang khugaḥ nad mug mtshon 'khrugs zhi bya'i phyiraX zas sman srung ba'i phywa g.yang khugaḥ dal 'byor don ldan 'grub pa'i phyir: bla ma dam pa'i tswa g.yang khugaḥ ji ltar 'dod pa 'i don grub phyiraḥ tshe chos nor gyi phywa g.yang khugaḥ dbang thang yon tan 'phel rgyas phyiraḥ dgra blage sar phywa g.yang khug sgrub tshug ri la zin pa'i phyiraX chos srung rgya mtsho'i phywa g.yang khugaḥ mthun rkyen 'byor ba phun tshogs phyiraḥ dkar phyogs skyongs ba'i phywa g.yang khug: bsam

dgu 'grub cing chos ltar 'tsho bkra shis dpal 'bar g.yang khu yeḥ de ring phywa g.yang khu ldan noḥ phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub stsol de ltar g.yang 'bod grangasabaskyar na skye dgu'i dpalayon 'byor ba yis dngos pos cha phran phywa g.yang brlanaḥ ji ltar 'dod pa'i don 'byung zhing lugs zungs dpal gyis phyug par 'gyuraḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang dad ldan slob bu bsod nams ming gis bkra shis wa regs bcas bskul ngor nus ldan pas spel ba maṅga lam/

—1) 'phags ma ku ru kul+le'i dgyes bskyed dbang gi bsregs blugs༄ sa med rgyun gyi nyams len bzhugs soḥn 31 gu nag ku na kul+le hrīX 24yi11goshi dbang shi 'om bu la sogs pa 'i bzang shing sna tshogs phye ma da dab sdud lcags kyu dmar po sogs me tog dmar po' rigs rnams bsdus mirnyi ra dang li khri dang 'bribargya'i mar khus sbam byug bya sngags da phyag rgyas sbya sa bsgyur spel par gsal ting 'dzin bstan po yis re thab khung bde ba'i rang bzhin 'bar me'i 11nga: zla gam dbang gi gzhal yas sgo gcig par: chu skyes zla nyi rtog med baṃ ro'i kharaḥ bde ba'i dbang phyug ku ru kuske'i zhalaX dmar gsal pad+ma ra ga'i lhun po laḥ nyin byed 'bum las 'khyud pa'i gzi byin 'baraḥ zhi ma khro'adzum spyan gsum mkha' la gzigasaḥ phyag bzhi pad+ma'i lcags zhags mda' gzhu 'geb ༷ stag sham rus rgyan dar dpyang nor bus sprasaḥ zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur rtog med ro la rolaX dbang gi 'od khyim rab tu 'bar zhing g.yo: bde stong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'du 'phro 'gyedaḥ sgog gis bskul te 'og min gnas mchog nasaX ye shes lha tshogs spran drangs

gnyis med bstimaḥ dam ye ro gcig bde ba chen por bzhugasaḥ ngo mtshar dad gus ldan pas phyag bgyi'o dngos 'byer yid sprul phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rgya mtshor bstod ram̐ḥ bde stong 'dzum pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor duḥ dam rdzas bdud rtsi bsreg jugs mchod pa 'bul dgyes bzhes bde stong ye shes rtsal 'bar zhing rnam mang phrin las rab 'byams thogs med sgrub ma ku ru kuspe hrīḥsarba byu dza khā hiX a hṝḥtriḥ.a gar+sha ya dzaḥshā be hoḥ brgya stong la sogs gang skabs phul 'dod don phrin las yad kyas smon sngags mchod phul zhing gzhung ltar bstod dbang gi 'gugs 'dren lcags kyu bskul yig brgya brjod bzhin bzod gsol phul bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab shesapa brjod cing me tog 'thor thabs desalha 'dre mi gsum 'duḥ dbang sdud che zhing zal gnon ldan mthu che grags snyan mchog tu 'bar sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya bdo thamaḥsnyiḥzhe pa'ang lung zin yo rgyan bstan 'dzana'as bkra shisadage ba'i skyesabacasabaskul ngor/ kho bo nusaldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis dbyangs snang mkha' 'gro'i bdo mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yag ye pa ni sngags gzhon 'byur med ming gas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo lam/

gas: zab tig las 'phags ma dbyangs can lha mo'i bsgom bzlas rmongs mun kun sel bzhugs soḥn mo dzñā na wāk+ka de wi swā ra swā bye za sa 17 mkhyen nu brtse ba'i dbang phyug dpa la ngag dbang dbya sa can lha cho la yid kyi 'khri shing g.yo bzhan btung byang chub bar du rjes su zungs 'jags tshogs lta dman zal gnon zhing spob pa'i gter brgyad 'byu ba da ཿ 'chad rtsod rtsom la dbang 'byar phyir 'phags ma 'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ra bya sa ma yāḥ a rang snang dag pa'i mos mtshor pad sdong kharaX chags sogs rdul bral zla ba nya gang steng hrīḥyig las byung ngag dbang dbyangs can maḥ dri med dung mdog nyi 'od 'byugs 'dra'i mdangs: 'dzum zhal blta bas mi ngom mtshan dpe'i 'byudaḥ rat+na'i mgul phreng do shal dbu rgyan mdzesaḥ ut+pal yi thod gdengs dri bsung 'thulaX phyag zhabs gdu bu 'ja' 'od dar sham bkraḥ srid zhi mnyam sbyor tsog su bsnol mar bzhugs gsung dbyangs drug cu'i chos sgo 'byed pa'i brdaraḥ phyag zung 'gyur khug stong ldan rgyud mang bsgringasaX rab gsal ma 'dres dngas ba sprul pa'i skuḥ brda don rtags kyi dag mdzod

longs spyod rdzogasaX 'od lus 'dzin med stong gsal chos dbyings yum sgyu 'phrul rdo rjer gnas yul mkha' 'gro rdzogasaḥ thugs sang mi 'gyur dpal gyi be'u rtsa gzhon nu zur phud lnga pa tshon gang baḥ mkhyen nus brtse ba'i dbang phyug dam par bzhugs rigs kyi bdag po smra ba'i seng ge niḥ legs bshad blo gros 'dzum brgya'i dpal du sharaḥ de nas zugasargyud bskul ba niḥ hrīX gsung gi dbang phyug 'asngam pa'i dpal bzang po smra ba'i nyi ma ye shes gter gcig pu: mtsho byung yid kyi 'khri shing dbyangs can maḥ thabs shes zung 'asdug phyag rgya'i rnam rol mchog mkhyen gzigs dbyings las brtse ba'i mdangs phyung la: dad ldan bdag gi jo gros pad mtshor rol 'pho med rtag pa'i rdo rjer mnyam bzhugs nas shes bya'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag 'byed nus pa'i klong rdol shes rab zab mo spral tu gsol: brgal dka' rmongs mun sems kyi dri ma kun dag chen ye shes chu yis sbyangs du gsol: ma rtog log mthong phyogs tsam dam par 'dzinaX rtog ge'i blo ngan sgron mes bsreg tu gsolaḥ 'jigs tshogs lta dman zil gnon blo las 'phagasaX nang don rig pa ye

badz+ra: shes mngon gyur shog ༷ de nas bzlas bskul niḥ hrīḥ skye med yi ge'i 'byung gnas ā gcig puX tshig tu brjod bral kun gyi rgyu ru gnas 'dod 'byung nor bu bsam 'phel las lhag pa'iḥ dge legs yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur dpalaḥ rgya mtsho che las phyogs bcu'i chu bran ltaraḥ thos pa'i nor rnams ster ba'i ma gcig puḥ nyi zla gsal ba'i 'od stong las lhag pa'iḥ mkhyen gnyis shes rab chags thogs bral ba'i mdzod dus kun mi nub sgrib bral mkhyen pa'i dpalaḥ ngag gi dbang phyug khyed bskul 'dzab mchod 'bul blo gros dpal ster dbya sa can lha mo la yid kyi 'khri shing grags stong gla yis bskulaḥ rab gus bstod dbyangs mchod sprin rgya mtshor rolaX lag pa'i lha mchog brtse bas zhal bstan nas0 mkhyen rab thugs rje'i 'od stong bdag la regaḥ ji ltar mkhyerdo zhing ci snyed gzigs pa yi thabs shes dgongs rgyud byin rlabs pha phog thob 'dzam gling mkhas grubarig 'dzin gral son nasaX rgyal bstan bshad dang sgrub pas 'dzin nus shingaX kun bzang thugs kyi bstan la dbang 'byor nasaḥ gol shor nor gsum rmongs pa'i smag brgal te

ji bzhin gzigs pa'i ye shes mngon gyur regagaḥ snyen dzñā na wāka de wi swā ra swā bye sarba pradzñā dzñā na ma hā sa ma dhi sirnyi pha la hūṃḥ dngas spro dgongs pa mi 'gyur bas shes rab blo 'phel bzlas sngags 'di/chu bo' rgyun bzhan dag par bsgrangs nyams rtogs yon tan blo gros rgyas shes rab blo rdol chos kun 'byed don gnyis grub par ze tshom bral sa ma yuḥskabasasu reg pa'i ngar bsnyed de 〉ngaḥ sgra dbug kyi rta la bskyon klong rdoladagongs pa'i gdangs bskyed na nyams rtogs yon tan mkha' ltar rgyasaḥ sa ma mā de nas gsol ba btab pa ni kye bde btagags mkhyen nus brtse ba'i gter gcig pu smra ba'i nyi ma ngag dbang yidamatshor skyes rig stong zung 'jug lhag pa'i lhar snang ba khyed la rtse gcig gsol ba btab lags naḥ bdag rmongs ma rig rab rib dri bsal nas 'chad rtsod rtsom la thogasamed mthu thob shog kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang phyug gsang gsum dang dbyer med ye shes rdo rje mngon gyur nas snang srid brda dpe lha sngags phyag rgyar sad kun rdzob mtshang rdolasgyu 'phrul lam gsang rtedaX don dam mtha' bral dbyings rig mngon gyur nas rdzogs pa chen po'i chos sku thob par shogaḥ dem thob par thos bsam bsgom pa'i mthil ston pa

bshā: mdzod ldan yon tan rgya mtsho lasaḥ mkhas pa gsum gyi thabs bzang gyi grangs 'byor mnyes pa gsum ldan dgongs rgyud 'pho bar shog rtogs pas bdag grolachags sogs nyon mongs zhiX nang don rig pa'i sa lam nyams rtsal rdzogasaḥ thugs rjes gzhan snang dge ba'i lam la sbyor rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod par mnga' brnyes 31gaḥ denasamachod pa niḥtrīḥ gzung ba rnam dag phyi mchod sprin ltar gtibasaḥ 'dzin pa rang grol nang mchod 'dod yon lngaX rkyen na lam slong glu pro phyag rgya garaX thams cad ma 'dres lhagapa'i lha la 'bul ro mnyam bde bas sku gsung thugs mchog bskangs dgongs rgyud byin rlabs rtogs pa'i yon tan bskyed ma ma hā pañtsa pu dza hoḥ de nas brtod pa niḥhrī mkhyen pas srid rtsa drungs 'byin ral gri 'dzinaḥ snying rjes gdul bya rtag skyong pad sdong brtenaḥ gsung dbyangs drug cu'i char 'bebs dbyangs can maḥ thabs shes sgyu 'phrul bkod laphyag 'tshal bstodaX de nas 'od zhu ni trī dad mos lcags kyus dpag yas mtsho 'gram nasaḥ dbyangs can 'khor bcas rang mdun nam mkhar dpagaḥ bskyed pa'i lha rnams 'od zhu

rten la thimaḥ de nyid chos kyi 'khor lor sim par dmigasaḥ o tsit+ta de snyi tsakra e me tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ de nas shisabarjod ni na mo rta bdun mu khyud bcu gnyis 'od stong gzisaḥ 'gro ba'i ma rig mun khams rab sangs nasaX shes bya'i gzhung lugs rab gsal jo gros kyisaX bshad sgrub snang ba yangs pa'i khyon la brdalaḥ bde gshegs kun tu bzang po'i smon lam mthus dus gsum kun khyab bkra shis dpal 'barathegag bajo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab shis pa brjod cing mnyam par bzhag gnad kyi jo gros nyams rtogs rgyas don gnyis lhun grub the tshom medaḥ sa ma yuḥrgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zimaḥsnyi shesarab blo 'phel ril bu niḥ a ru skyu ru bi pi ling shing mngar dug nyung sgron shing dang 'jam dpal rtags ngu arwa wa dang gur gum cu gang go snyod rnams zhib btab mngar gsum gyisadril nas ril bu sran 'bra'i tshad tsam bya tsa gong rnal yad byas pa yisaḥ zhag bdun gyis ni tig pa 'dags bcu gcig skad gdang khyung ltar snyan bcu gnyas mi brjed gzungs dang ldan bcu gsum blo gros mtha' masathob blo ba gcig brten sha rus srar sgas med la tsho dar ba sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab poḥ sa ma yuḥshesarab blo 'phel za yig ni shog dkar dri ma bral ba'i ngor bzang drug chos sman bsres pa'i snag dra bzang ldan pa 'di ltar brtsams

—8rdo: 'byu gcig shrīng sgra stong brjod nas rab tu gnas shing me tog 'thor de nas yar tshes bzang po dang 'chad rtsod rtsom la sbyor tshe rol shes rab me ltar 'bar bar 'gyur sam yā rgyargyargyaḥ ces pa 'di 'ang lugs gnyis kyi bya bar mkhas pa gtso cher smra ba'adage btsun sa mu tra'i ming gi mtha' rgyan can gyis bkra shis pa reg ran chen gnyis pa'i skyes bcas bskul ro ra dus mtha'igater ming 'dzin panus ldan rdo rjesaspel ba dge legs 'phel sabo ma be lam/

badz+ra: 'phags ma'i tshogs mchod niX lor rgas bsags la 'di skad doḥnyo bde ba chen po'i sgod mchog zhu blang dor gnyis med dam tshig rdzasaḥ sku gsung thugs su byin brlabs nas0 dpag yas nam mkha'i sprin du spelaX o ā ༷kaka kakaka brtse'i gter chen 'jams dpal dbyangasaX ngag dbang dad mtshor dgyes pa moX thabs shes zung 'jug lhagapa'i lhaX 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs phyi nang gsang ba'i dga' ston 'bulaX dam tshig nyams pa bskang zhing bshagasaḥ gnyis snang mtshan ma chos skur bsgral dag chen mnyam rol bde klong bstabs 'khrul ba ka nas dag gyur cigaḥdangos po chos kyi dbyings su bskangasaḥ gsal ba shes rab ngang du bskangs snang ba ye shes klong du bskangs bdesdug ka nas dag par bskangasaḥ bskang bya skong byed bral bar bskangasaḥ 'khor gsum yongs dag ngang la bzhagaḥ dmigs bcas bsod nams bsags pa'i dgesaḥ gang 'dul phrin las 'byung gyur cigaḥ dmigs med ye shes dag pa'i mthus chos sku khyab brdal mngon gyur shogaḥ bstan pa de 'dzin dar zhing rgyasaḥ skye rgu bde skyid dpal thob shog dus

hūṃ tī 'khor 'das khyab brdal dbyings kyi bdud rtsi 'di0 ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mkha' ru rnam par sproX rten 'brel bcu gnyis dbyings sbyor shes rab khragaḥ dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i bde ba'i gsos su sbyaraX tshogs brgyad ro mnyam ye shes bā lirnyiḥ chos nyid mkha' 'gros chos khams stongs phyir stobasaḥ khams gsum kun gsal rig pa'i mar me 'di:sha za mkha' 'gro dbyings su phyogs phyir sbaraX dug lnga ro mnyam dza gad sngags kyi rdzas lta spyod tha snyad spros pa dag phyir 'bulaḥ dgyes bzhes yid chos 'phrang las bdag bsgral teḥ ye rdzogs sku gsum rang chas rdzong zin nas nyag gcig kun tu bzang po'i sgog zob re gaḥ rnal 'byor lam gyi cha lag ṣā rang rig pad+ma rgyal pos mdzad rig pa rang lam byed pa'i sras 'od gsal rdo rje'i dpal du sharaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya chos bdag kun bzang nor bu'i ngor bdud 'dul nus ldan rdo rjes so/ maṅga lam/

ba tshu rin chen snod du gtor skyems bshams sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgyur spel lhar gsal tang 'dzan brtan po yis srung ma'i thugs dam bskang ba ni bh+yo dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs ma'ispongaX pad+ma nyi zla ru tra pho mo'i kharaḥ bh+yoḥ las bcu bdun rgyud kyi srung ma niḥ spug nag 'od 'phrosadabu dgu bco brgyad phyag spyan ni gcig gcig theg pa rim dgu srung chems nibastan pa so so'i dgra la rngamasaX g.yu yi ral gcig a ti snying po 'dzin rtsa phyag zhing bcu'i snying dang lcags spyang 'dzin g.yas kyi lhag ma thabs mtshon phyag brgyad na skye medarang ngo spros pa'i cang te'u 'brol shes rab don mtshon g.yon gyi phyag brgyad na 'khor ba ma spang gzhir rdzogs bhan khrag 'chang nu g.yas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi sgrub mchog skyong g.yon par khrag 'bebs dgra la dal yams 'gyed sprin dkar thul pa mgo phreng mi lpags klubasaḥ zhabs ni skye med stong pa'i dbyings su gab sprul pa 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro sa ya 'gyed: kun kyang rnal 'byor sgrub pa po la gdung: gsang sngags bstan pa mchog la rtag par gnas: dad pas 'bod do ma g.yel da tshur byon dam tshig sgrub rdzas

badz+ra: srog 'khor rten la bzhugs: rnam mang mchod sprin rgya mtshos dgyes pa bskangs ༷ thugs mthun yo byad rgya mtshos mngon par bstodaḥ sgrub pa po yi grogs su mnga' gsol loḥ ma chen khyod la bu yis rtag tu bstod rtag tu brtse zhing gdung ba'i dam tshig gisaḥ nyin mtshan tshe rabs kun du 'bral med 'grogasaḥ nyams dang rtogs pa yar ngos zla ltar spel sgyu las 'od skur spyor ba'i grogs mo mdzod: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral skyel bsu pyos: kun bzang gdod ma'i sa la sbyor bar mdzod: thugs bskyed dam bca' phrin las ma g.yel b.raX rdo rje pad+ma'i gnyer dam bsgo ba bzhinaḥ rig 'dzin bdag gi grogs mdzod mel brtses skyongs don gnyis lhun gyis grub mdzod dam tshig can:rje ma ma 6) ka dza ṭi sarba sa pa ri wā ra pa(mi a dṛ ta rak+ta bā ladhi khā hiḥ gra sa bsogs bsags dang gtor skyems 'bul phrin las rab 'byams thogs med 'grub the tshom med do rdo rje' bka' bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsalaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thamaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa 'di yang chos bdag rin chen dpal bzang ngo sa bskur ngoraḥ 7 kho bo rig 'dzan gter bzhad snying pos mkha' 'gro'i brda ras las dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa na chos

badz+ra dam chos sprul sku'i snying thig lasaḥ rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'iḥ dgyes bskang srag blugs ting 'dzin rab spel bzhugs so:na 31 dzñā na sa ra dzuḥ sha nasaspyozhes— rnal 'byor sgrub la snying rus can blo gsal ti 'dzin brtan thob pas rtogs pa mkha' ltar rgyas pa' phyir mkha' 'gro'i dgyes bskang sreg blugs brtsonaḥ sa ma māḥ thab dkyil slo gam rdul tshon bkye bzang po' shing gis me hom brtsigs sreg rdzas 'bras dkar dkar gsum sbyar mngar gsum 'o mas brlan par bya sngags da phyag rgyas zad med spel lar gsal rnal 'byer zhi rgyan bgo shar gyi phyogs su shas kyu zhing rdo rje dril bu'i dam tshig bcing thab la me sbar bya ba ni hūṃ hrīḥ me ni bde ba chen po'i mdangs0 mtshan ma'i chos rnams stong par byed: gzung 'dzin rtogs tshogs bud shing sregaḥ ye shes rtsi ni kun khyab blugs pad+ma ḍāk+ki ni ba lo ka dz+wa la ram̐ reḥ thabakhang bskyed pa ni snya mtshan 'dzin chos kyi dbyings su brdal lhun grub yum lnga'i mkha' klong duḥ rgyu rkyen las 'das gzhal med khang bde chen zla gam dbang gi dal 'bar ba'i 'od zer kun nas 'khyug bde stong pad zla nyi ma'i khar rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar gsal gcer

mo dor stabs bzhengasaX phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te'i sgras dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma tshogs bskulaḥ g.yon pas gri gug dku la brtenaḥ 'khor 'das gnyis med mnyam nyid ston nu ma 'bur zhing pad+mo rgyas zung 'jug ye shes bu la stsolaḥ dbu skra thor cog pad+mas bcing: gnag snum zar bu sku rgyab 'phyingaX rus pa'i rgyan drug dar dpyangs mdzes sku la 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro rdzogs rigs bdag gu ru a tsar+ya dkar dmar mdangs ldan gri thod 'dzin dgyes brtse'i 'od zer bu la phyogasaḥ rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs stong gsal dal brgyud gsum bla ma'i ngo bor sharaḥ thabs shes sgog gi yi ge lasaḥ 'od 'phros ye shes lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstimaḥ spyan 'dren niḥ / hrīX yul gyi ming ni rnga yab glingaḥ zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse mo na ༷ pho brang pad+ma 'od klong nas 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i spyi rje moḥ dad pas 'bod do dgongs rgyud bskulaḥ rtsal mdangs bu yi mos ngor byonaḥ sa dzña na sa ra dzu e h+ya hiḥ bzhugs gsol na hrīX rab gsal gzhal yas 'od re 'baraḥ nyi zla pad+ma mdangs dang ldan dam tshig dkyil 'khor ma 'dres shar de laye

badz+ra shes mkha' 'gro bzhugasaḥ sa ma ya dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ phyaga'atshal ni na moḥ skyob med pa rdo rje'i sku 'gags dang brdzod med don gyi gsungaḥganas dang 'khrul bral ye shesathugasaḥ mkha' 'gro'i gsang gsum la phyag 'tshalaX sa ma ya na mo hoX mchodapa niḥ shā trīḥ chos nyid stong pa'i klongs yangs suḥ chos can rgyan gyi bye brag kunaḥ ma bzung yul snang dag par bkodaḥ ma dmigs 'dzin pa grol ba'i sprinaX ye rdzogs sku gsum mkha' 'gro ma 'bum phrag yangs pa'i dal du 'bulaḥ rlung sems sgyu lus ka dag steḥ ma khyed gsang gsum mngon gyur cigaḥ tho ma hā pu dza badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ sngags tshig gis phyi nang gsang mchod rgyas par 'bul byon skyems niḥ snye āḥshāḥ bdoba'i rgyas 'debs rtsi yi mchog ye shes dngas ma bcud kyi mchog shes rab rnon po mtshon kyi mchogaX de las ye shes mkha' 'gro dgyesaX mnyam pa chen por 'bul lags naḥ gnyis su med par bzhes su gsolaḥ rtsa sngags mthar pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hiḥ nyer gcig gis 'bul loḥ sreg rdzas 'bul ba ni rtu trīX gtsang mar sbyar ba dkar gyi mchogaḥ bde bar sbrar ba mngar gyi bcudaḥ gnyis su med par sbrar ba 'diX ye

shes mkha' 'gro'i dal du 'bulaḥ rtogs pa mkha' ltar rgyas pa dngaX ye shes thugs kyi dngos grub stsol rtsasngags mthar badz+ra ma le puṣ+ṭa ye pra dzñā dzñā na sa mā dhi sirnyi pha la hūṃ yisabargya rtsa re phul la 'dod gsol niḥhoḥ rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang mo'i gsang ba gsum gyi dal duḥ mnyam nyid bdud rtsir sbyar ba'i sreg rdzas ye shes kyi rang bzhin du shar ba 'bul zhing stobs lags naḥ lhan skyes kyis rtogs pa mkha' ltar khyon yangs shing ye shes kyi rang 'od nyi ma'i zer ltar phyogs med du 'jug pa'i sgo dang klong rdol shes rab zab mo'i sgo 'phel nas sgom sgrub 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdag la stsol cigaḥ de ltar spel la grangs mang 'bul bstod pa ni sne trīḥ mthong bas yid 'phrog 'dzum sgegs zhal bzang canaḥ thos pas rnam grol brda chos bu la ngoms dran pas zhi lhag rig pa'i dga' ston ster lhan skyes mkha' 'gro khyod la gus pas bstodaX tshogs snon 'bul mchod gtor gtong gto rag niḥ ( hrīḥ ye shes ting 'dzin las byung ba'i phyi nang gsang mchod dga' ston 'di ḍak+ki'i rje mo mtsho rgyal mar bka' drin

badz+ra gtang rag 'bul gyi bzhesaḥ ma hā pu dza sa ma ya hoḥ tshogs skyems ni / hrīX rtsi bcud dngas ma zhun mar 'diḥ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje rnal 'byor maraḥ gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes: bdag ni rjes su bzung du gsol rtsa sngags mthar pañtsa.adṛ ta khā hiḥ nyer gcag gis phul dngos grub ni / hrīḥ ting 'dzin gsal ba'i me long ngor mkha' 'gro'i gzigs pa'i zhal bzang ngomasaḥ gsang ba gsum gyi dbang dngos grubaḥ mngon sum snang bar stsal du gsolaḥ sirnyi pha la a la la hoḥ sngags mchod 'bul bstod pa niḥhrīḥsnying dbus dhu ma tha la'i grongaḥ lha skyes 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i rje bde sbyin rdo rje rnal 'byor mar ༷ blo bral rig pa rjen pas bstodaḥ ba rim ni snya ma skyes rang gsal mkha' 'gro'i dal sgyu 'phrul 'gags med bkod pa kun rig stong nyi zla'i ga'ur bsduḥ yid chos spros pa chos skur bzhagaḥ a āḥ bsngo smon ni ho sems kyis bzos pa'i chos rnams kunaX don dam spros mtha' bral bar bsngoX nang dbyings ka dag rnal 'byor ma'iḥ gsang ba gsum du smin rdzogs shogaḥ shisabarjod ni na yo ye shes thugs ni phyogs res bralaḥ

bde chen sku mchog yongs su mnyamaX brjod med gsung gis chos khams khyab gsang gsum 'khor los bkra shis shogaXphan bde legs yon 'byung ba'i gzhi kun bzang bstanapa dar ba dngaḥrig 'dzin 'dus sde rab rgyas nas phun tshogs sgrub pas mdzes gyur cig ye nas 'gyur med de bzhin nyidaXrang bzhin 'gyur med gnyug ma'i gsang:stong pa 'gyur med nam mkha' cheḥ'agyur med don rtogs shis pa stsolaḥgazung ba yul gyi bud shing dang 'dzin pa sems kyi sreg rdzas kun shes rab me yis mthar mdzad pa'i 'bar ba'i mkha' 'gros shis pa stsol0 nyin yang bkra shis 'od gsal klong mtshan yang bkra shis rig pa'i ngang rtag par bkra shis rdzogs pa chesaX gdul zhing yongs khyab shis pa stsolaX bzhan yang shis brjod rgya cher bya des ni tshogs gnyisardzogs pa dang nyamasartog mkha' ltar 'phel rgyasanas kun tu bzang po' sathob 'gyuraḥs ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥdziḥzhes pa 'di'ang chosabadag rin chen dpal bzang po sa bkra shis lha reg rin chen gnyis pa'i skyes bcas bskur ngoraḥ7 kho bo khrag 'thung gter bzhad snying pos mkha' 'gro'i brda las dag par phab pa' ya ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyi pa dgesabo maṅga lam/

por rjes yi rang zangs thal rtogs pa'i chos 'khor bskul dus gsum 'gyur med bzhugs gsol 'debasaḥ dge tshogs 'khor gsum dag par bsngo gdod ma'i grol gzhi mngon gyur phyir sdom gsum bslab bya dam tshig 'dzinaX rtogs pa don gyi dbang bskur mchog mos ldan bdag la gnang bar zhu dmachuni kye nyo tshur re ga rig pa 'dzin pa rnamasaḥ rdo rje'i chu 'di lce yis spyodaḥ dam tshig sgog ni sems la thob 'dzin stangs ka nas dag gi bar: gsang chen lta spyod nyams med srungasaḥ tha snyad tsam 'dir khyod nyams na rten 'brel tsam gyi dmyal bar spyodaḥ dbang gis 'tshing ba'i skal ba medaḥ de phyir dran dang bag yod mdzod badz+ra sa ma ya na ra kān ma ga dar bkab cing me tog sbyin slob ma lhar gsal ye shes dbab de nas 'dangs ba bsal ba niḥhoX thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas kyang ma rig dbang gis zhal ma masngal da ni lhag mthong rig pa'i brdasaḥ mtshan ma'i bag bcom phyir bsal0 chags tsakyu pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ me tog 'bul ba ni hoḥ rig dang dkyil 'khor lhun rdzogs pa'i ja ma lha yi sku drung du rig pa'i me tog phyag bcas 'bul brtse bas

badz+ra: bzhes la rjes su zungasaX puṅge na ma hoḥ mthong ba bstan pa niḥ e ma hoX snang ba gdod nas mkha' spyod zhingaḥ srid pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dalaḥ sems nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor maḥ gnas yul dur khrod he ru ga phyi nang gsang ba zung 'brel tshulaḥ lhan skyes dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i grong khyer mchog gsang mngon gyur na: tshogs kyi dbang phyug rgyalapor 'gyuraX don 'di rtog mdzod skal ba canaḥ a a a phaṭaḥ bum pa' brda thabs kyas sku yi dab sbyan pa ni hūṃ hrīḥ bum pa stong gsal dbyings kyi nga lhun grub bum bcud bdud rtsir 'khyil skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bsaḥ snang stong zung 'jug don rtogs teX phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor spyod gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar kāya a bhi ṣiñtsa tsheḥ bhan dha'i brda thabs kyisagasung gi dbang sbyin pa ni hūṃ hrīX bhan dha bde chen klong yangs par byang chub sems bcud dkar dmar 'khyil skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bsaḥ sgo gsum bde ba cher smin nas gsal stong zung 'jug don rtogs te jags kyi dkyil 'khor spyod gyur cigaḥ rtsa jags mtharaḥ wāk+kas bhi ṣiñtsa ā0 rig ma'i brda thabs kyis thugs kyi dab sbyin pa niḥ / hrī lha klu bram ze

rigs ngan mo bde ba sbyin pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bsaḥ sgo gsum 'dzin zhen rang grol nasaḥ bde stong zung 'asdug don rtogs teḥ bha ga'i dkyil 'dza ra spyod gyur cig rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta.abhi ༷nga /tsho sher dkar gyis brda thabs kyis ye shesakyis dbang sbyin pa niḥ shā hrīḥ dri med shel gyi gong bu laX 'od lnga lhun grub rang chas rdzogs skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bsaḥ sgo gsum spros pa ka dag nasaḥ rig stong zung 'asdug ngo 'phrod de dbyings ye gnyis med spyod gyur cig rtsasngags mtharaḥ sarba.a bhi ṣiñtsa trī mtha' rtenagatad cing shis pa brjod dbang yon snang srid sngos sngangs 'bul srog la cig char dam tshig 'dzan yon tan nyams rtog lo 'bras sminaḥ sa lam mthar phyan rdzogs sa sargyas the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya ༷/༵ ṭ+wāṃd sbyiX ṭ+wāṃs/ ༷ ༷ṭ+wāṃ/༵ ༷sa bdag ranachen dpal bzang posabakra shas la reg rin chen gnyas pa'i skyes bcas bskur ngor 7 kho bo khrag 'thung gter bzhad snyang pos mkha' 'gro'i ba las dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni choso
